<traits>

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 610

The opaque crystal lenses of these sleek goggles do not obscure vision, but rather enhance it. While wearing the goggles, you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks involving sight.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Rotating the lenses 90 degrees, you gain darkvision for 1 hour.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 19"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Golden Gloves](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3647)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Holy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=517" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #206: Bring the House Down](/Sources.aspx?ID=247) pg. 82

**Price** 40,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn gloves

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These golden-threaded gloves fit snuggly past the elbows, and imbue all other worn clothing with an aristocratic mien. The gloves grant you a +3 item bonus to [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47) skill checks. When you [invest](/Actions.aspx?ID=2799) the gloves, you either increase your Intelligence score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score. This gives you additional trained skills and languages, as normal for increasing your Intelligence modifier. You must select skills and languages the first time you invest the gloves, and whenever you invest the same golden gloves, you get the same skills and languages you chose the first time. If you are [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), you become [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) 2 when invested in these gloves.

**Activate—Heaven's Wings** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You throw wide your arms, putting the golden gloves on full display and causing a blazing halo to form above your head. All enemies within a 40-feet [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) must make a DC 41 Fortitude save or be [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 minute (or [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) for 1 minute on critical failure). [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) creatures take a –2 item penalty to their roll. The halo then melts into your body and attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) any one [affliction](/Rules.aspx?ID=2389) you are currently suffering of your choice with a counteract rank of 9 and a counteract modifier of +31.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title

    right="Item 5"
    pfs=""
>
[Grasp of Droskar](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1729)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Crown of the Kobold King</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Crown of the Kobold King](/Sources.aspx?ID=148) pg. 115

**Price** 155 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn glove

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Gauntlet](/Weapons.aspx?ID=4)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [gauntlet](/Weapons.aspx?ID=4)_ appears little more than a dull, soot-stained, metal-plated glove at first glance, but in truth it is an invasive boon granted by [Droskar](/Deities.aspx?ID=28) to his most faithful subjects. Placing the glove on your hand causes excruciating pain as your appendage curls into a tight fist and then slowly transforms to a supernaturally hard ball of black stone, fusing to you and preventing you from using this hand for anything other than gauntlet Strikes or the _grasp of Droskar's_ activated abilities (a _grasp of Droskar_ does not have the [free-hand](/Traits.aspx?ID=181) weapon trait). The gauntlet can't be removed without a successful casting of [_remove curse_](/Spells.aspx?ID=250) or a similar spell. The gauntlet reverts to normal (and can be removed with ease) if the curse is removed, the hand is removed from the body, or the wearer dies.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You gain a +1 item bonus on all Athletics checks for 1 minute.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You cast [_ray of enfeeblement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=244) with a spell attack modifier of +10 and a DC of 20.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[Gravedigger's Call](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3846)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=120" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 127

**Price** 1,700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Glaive](/Weapons.aspx?ID=375)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This rusted shovel functions as a _[+2 striking ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [decaying ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2835) [glaive](/Weapons.aspx?ID=375)_ when wielded as a weapon, but it more closely resembles a neglected tool. Its haft was carved from the trunk of a long-dead tree that once grew among the broken stones of an abandoned cemetery, and its blade was forged from shattered remnants of the armor that failed to protect those buried there. When you carry or wield a gravedigger’s call, you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to Seek haunts and to skill checks to determine the reasons for a haunt or spirit’s existence.

**Activate—Call the Fallen** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You cast [_rouse skeletons_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2019) as a 5th-rank [occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) spell. The DC is 30.

**Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of _rouse skeletons_ (5th rank).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.markdown:
May contain spoilers from Bastion of Blasphemies **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 239 **Price** 160 gp **Usage** worn belt --- This long, scarf-like garment appears to be made of living vines on which a dozen black roses bloom. While the vines appear to be thorny, they lack the capability to puncture or scratch, allowing the garland to be worn comfortably as a scarf or belt. The scent of the black roses evokes faint feelings of melancholy and nostalgia to the living, but undead find the odor to be unnerving and distracting. As long as you have a _graverose garland_ invested, it grants a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) and [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks against undead. **Activate—To the Grave with You!** ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), manipulation, [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You lift some of the garland to your lips and blow, sending the scent of the black roses outward to target an undead creature you can see within 60 feet. The targeted undead becomes filled with the conviction that it belongs in its grave, and it must attempt a DC 19 Will save against the following effects. **Critical Success** The undead creature is unaffected.
**Success** The undead creature becomes [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) until the start of your next turn.
**Failure** The undead creature becomes [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 2 and is off-guard as long as it remains frightened.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but frightened 3, and the undead is also [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=74) as long as it remains frightened. If the undead knows of a nearby empty grave, it must flee toward that grave—if it enters the grave, it drops [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) into the grave and remains prone until it is no longer frightened.

Caution and misdirection are the hallmarks of your hold. You’ve encountered more travelers than most of Belkzen’s holds ever see, and you need to understand how to deal with them. The tattoo’s grim appearance can help mask your true motivations. You gain a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) checks to [Feint](/Actions.aspx?ID=1434).

**Activate—Unexpected Strike** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) a creature that has the [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) condition with a weapon attack;  **Effect** You deal an extra 1d6 precision damage to the target.

When opened, this grimoire has unlimited pages that, oddly, seem almost eager to transcribe spells. Unlike most grimoires, it has no limits to its number of spells. The grimoire’s eagerness to contain your spells grants you a +1 item bonus to checks to [Learn a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2366) if you do so by transcribing the spell into the grimoire. If you use the grimoire during your daily preparations and are capable of preparing spells of the appropriate rank, the grimoire’s nature leaks into your mind, allowing you to prepare an additional 1st-rank spell.

**Activate—Bleeding Rubies** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You have a free hand and your last action was to deal damage to an enemy with a [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) or spell attack roll; **Effect** You pull a ruby off your belt and crush it into dust. As this dust reaches the enemy you just harmed, it embeds into the skin, causing them to bleed. The target takes 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86). The ruby reappears on the belt after 24 hours.

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Gatewalkers</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Gatewalkers (Hardcover)](/Sources.aspx?ID=290) pg. 230

</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

These black leather goggle frames have no lenses. Instead, when a character puts them on and invests them, the wearer’s eyes transform and lengthen into snail-like eyestalks. The wobbly eyestalks stretch out through the lens holes and up over the wearer’s head on lengthened optic nerves.

**Activate—Looksee** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** By focusing hard, you can watch for enemies in all directions. You gain [all-around vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=49) for 1 minute; during this time, you can’t be [flanked](/Rules.aspx?ID=2375).

>
[Stampede Medallion](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5189)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Eidolon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=386" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 245

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

When crafted, a _stampede medallion_ looks like nothing more than small silver disk, about the same size as a silver piece. When you invest this medallion for your eidolon, it changes shape to appear as a tiny, bejeweled facsimile of the eidolon, magically attached just over your eidolon’s heart. While your eidolon wears the medallion, they gain a +2 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks to [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380) or [Trip](/Actions.aspx?ID=2382). 

**Activate—Impossible Tide** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Your eidolon momentarily manifests into a stampede of dozens of copies of themself. The stampede rampages out in every direction, swerving around your allies while trampling any foe on the ground in an [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) around your eidolon with a radius equal to your eidolon’s Speed. Each of these foes takes 8d6 bludgeoning damage, with a DC 29 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save. On a critical failure, the foe is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88). After dealing damage, the stampede of eidolons vanishes as quickly as it appeared.

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 6+"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Stormshard](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3742)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Triumph of the Tusk</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #208: Hoof, Cinder, and Storm](/Sources.aspx?ID=250) pg. 78

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These shards of coalesced necromantic essence are sometimes found in the wake of an ancestor storm. Howling spirits are faintly visible, trapped inside the jagged, dark-green glass.

You can use the shard to cow the [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) or briefly release the tormented souls from inside the glass. While you hold the stormshard, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks to [influence](/Rules.aspx?ID=1830) the undead. In addition, you can [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) undead creatures, even if those creatures are [mindless](/Traits.aspx?ID=652) or otherwise [immune](/Rules.aspx?ID=2313) to [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), or [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects.

**Activate—Free the Spirits** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You briefly release the spirits from the _stormshard_ before drawing them back into the glass. Each creature in a 10-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) takes 4d8 [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510) damage (DC 20 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2247) Fortitude save). You treat the result of your saving throw as one degree of success better than its outcome.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title

pfs="Limited"
>
Greater Stormshard
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #208: Hoof, Cinder, and Storm](/Sources.aspx?ID=250) pg. 79

**Price** 1,800 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The item bonus increases to +2. When activating the _stormshard_ to release the spirits, the damage increases to 8d8 (DC 29). In addition, you can choose to increase the radius of the [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) by up to 10 feet.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 5"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Grim Ring](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1538)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Detection" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=43" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Book of the Dead](/Sources.aspx?ID=118) pg. 19

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This golden ring is sculpted with the visage of a grinning skull on the side. While wearing the ring, you can attempt to detect the presence of [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creatures as an [exploration](/Traits.aspx?ID=66) activity. This reveals the presence or absence of undead in the area, but it doesn't pinpoint their locations. This ring can't detect undead whose appearance is masked by any [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92) spell that is 2nd level or higher. If an undead is hiding or disguised, the GM rolls a secret Perception check for you against the undead's [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) or [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) DC, as appropriate, with a +2 item bonus to your check.

</row>

---

First developed in the Puddles about 20 years ago, this stimulant has grown from a diversion of the wretched poor to a habit for well- heeled merchants and nobles. At low doses, grit provides the physical body with increased energy while stimulating the idle mind into effortless flights of creative fancy. Abuse of the drug leads to severe hallucinations, numbing, and uncontrollable rage. Grit is produced by grinding down alchemically-enhanced barbarian chew, which is mixed with toxic plant- based substances, such as bitterbark or redroot. The powder is very expensive and highly addictive.

The save for addiction to grit is DC 15, and the addiction has the [virulent](/Traits.aspx?ID=162) trait.

 **Saving Throw** DC 15 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 minute; **Maximum Duration** 4 hours; **Stage 1** +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4), and [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks (10 minutes); **Stage 2** +1 item bonus to Athletics, Crafting, and Performance checks, –2 item penalty to Perception checks (1 hour); **Stage 3** –4 item penalty to Perception checks (1 hour); **Stage 4** as stage 3 (1 hour); **Stage 5** [confusion](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5) (1 round); **Stage 6** [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38) (remaining duration)

---

This [caligni](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=18)-made, murky-green drug supercharges a creature's olfactory senses at the expense of dulling their mind. Popular throughout the Darklands for its ability to transform normally dull scents and flavors into intense, euphoric experiences, grolna can also be a great aid to trackers who want to follow scent trails, turning ordinary humanoids into effective bloodhounds.

 Taking an additional dose of grolna while affected by the effects of stage 1 of a previous dose resets the duration of stage 1 and postpones the onset of stage 2 effects.

 **Saving Throw** DC 13 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 minute; **Maximum Duration** 8 hours; **Stage 1** gain [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) (imprecise) 30 feet, gain a +3 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks to follow tracks, and become [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) (1 hour); **Stage 2** stupefied 2 (6 hours)

Taking an additional dose of grolna while affected by the effects of stage 1 of a previous dose resets the duration of stage 1 and postpones the onset of stage 2 effects. Saving Throw DC 13 Fortitude; Onset 1 minute; Maximum Duration 8 hours; Stage 1 gain scent (imprecise) 30 feet, gain a +3 item bonus to Survival checks to follow tracks, and become stupefied 1 (1 hour); Stage 2 stupefied 2 (6 hours)

[Grub Gloves](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2561)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 87

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn gloves

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Danila Kenn and Depa Stepwell of Common Goods developed these gloves after complaints from an exhausted grindlegrub rancher. Since their development, the gloves have become popular not just among grindlegrub ranchers, but laborers of all kinds in Stonebreach. The thick gloves are designed to help ranchers hold on to the squirming, slimy bodies of grindlegrubs, and help soothe the wear and tear of the day while restoring energy for after-hours pursuits. While wearing the gloves, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks. The gripping power of the gloves provides you with a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves to [Grab an Edge](/Actions.aspx?ID=95). If you roll a success to Grab an Edge, you get a critical success instead, as the _gripping gloves_ allow you to hold on even with just a few fingertips.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You rub your hands together and take a deep breath to prepare for the rest of your day. You regain 3d8+10 Hit Points and feel refreshed, losing the [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15) condition. As normal for effects that remove fatigue, this doesn't remove any underlying source of fatigue, such as lack of sleep, causing the condition to return if the underlying source isn't addressed.

</column>

>
[Guangu of the Steppe](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3937)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 144

**Price** 225 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This large drum is made of hardwood and horse hide, with white silhouettes of coursing stallions along its circumference. This drum grants you a +1 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks while playing music with the instrument.

**Activate—The Hammer of Hooves** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You hammer a thundering beat on the guangu. For 10 minutes, mounted allies within a 60-foot emanation gain a +10-foot status bonus to their mount’s Speeds. They also gain a +1 status bonus to [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43) checks to [Command an Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=2400) and automatically succeed when they Command an Animal they’re mounted on to take a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=658) action (such as [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305)).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 16"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Guiding Chisel](/Equipment.aspx?ID=541)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Age of Ashes</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Elf" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=58" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City](/Sources.aspx?ID=13) pg. 76

**Price** 10,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This magical chisel evokes the holy symbol of the elven goddess of art and architecture, Findeladlara. The _Guiding Chisel’s_ original function was as a portal key to Duskgate, but as Alseta’s Ring faded from the collective memories of the elves, the chisel became known and used exclusively for its other abilities. Eventually, elven emissaries gave it to the dwarves of Saggorak as a gesture of friendship.

 You gain a +3 item bonus to Crafting checks related to stonemasonry. In addition, it takes you only 1 day to Craft items using the _Guiding Chisel_ instead of 4 days, and you quadruple the discount you get for spending additional days Crafting items with the _Guiding Chisel_. If it’s unclear whether you could use the _Guiding Chisel_ to Craft an item, the GM decides.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes (command, envision, Interact);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You embed the _Guiding Chisel_ in the ground and imagine a building. After 10 minutes, you remove the chisel and the building appears. The building can take any shape you wish, filling up to ten contiguous 10-foot cubes within 1,000 feet of the chisel. The building lasts until you use the chisel to create another building. This building has the [structure](/Traits.aspx?ID=153) trait.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

    pfs="Limited"
>
[Hairpin of Blooming Flowers](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3134)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 73

**Price** 360 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The flower that adorns this hairpin is a blooming lotus flower that varies in color; it regrows in a day after the item is activated. Whether or not the hairpin's flower is in bloom, as long as you wear it and it's invested, it grants a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks. 

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You pluck the flower from the hairpin and scatter the petals, creating a flurry of color in a 10-foot burst centered on you. You become concealed for 1 minute or until you move from your current location. Any creature within the 10-foot burst when you Activate the Item must succeed at a DC 23 Reflex save or become [dazzled ](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) until the end of its next turn (or [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) until the end of its next turn on a critical failure). The flower blooms again the next day.

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Hat of Many Minds](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1060)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 185

**Price** 1,800 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This pointy, brimmed hat made up of a rainbow patchwork of various materials seems to sit just a little lopsided on your head, no matter how you adjust it. You gain a +2 item bonus to checks to [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23).

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You tear off a patch of cloth to manifest it into a copy of yourself, dressed in the color and fabric of the patch. The copy follows your specific instructions and performs a single, straightforward task for up to 30 minutes. It takes the copy three times as long to complete the task as it would you, meaning it can perform a task that would take you a maximum of 10 minutes. It doesn't react quickly enough to be of any use during an encounter, and it can't use your spells or other special abilities—just basic actions and skill actions.

 The copy disappears and returns to the hat as a piece of cloth when the given task has been completed, or when you Dismiss the activation.

</column>

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Price** 1,800 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This pointy, brimmed hat is made up of a rainbow patchwork of various materials and seems to sit just a little lopsided on your head, no matter how you adjust it. You gain a +2 item bonus to checks to [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=2364) as the hat subtly helps with the tedious but important work that any given job might require. 

**Activate—Patchwork Double** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You tear off a patch of cloth to manifest it into a copy of yourself, dressed in your normal clothes, though they resemble the color and fabric of the patch. The copy follows your specific instructions and performs a single, straightforward task for up to 30 minutes. It takes the copy three times as long to complete the task as it would you, meaning it can perform a task that would take you a maximum of 10 minutes. It doesn’t react quickly enough to be of any use during an encounter, and it can’t use your spells or other special abilities—just basic actions and skill actions. The copy disappears and returns to the hat as a piece of cloth when the given task has been completed or when you [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) Patchwork Double.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 5"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Heartripper Blade](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1730)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Crown of the Kobold King</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Crown of the Kobold King](/Sources.aspx?ID=148) pg. 115

**Price** 160 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This wicked-looking curved weapon is a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)_ that draws power from defeating foes, either to bolster itself or its wielder. A _heartripper blade_ is well suited for use in any ritual that involves divination, and incorporating it into any ritual with the [divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47) trait grants the wielder a +1 item bonus on any check made to resolve the effects of the ritual's casting.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You reduce a foe to 0 Hit Points with a Strike from the _heartripper blade_;  **Effect** The _heartripper blade_ draws power from the devastating strike, causing its blade to erupt in black flames. For 1 minute, Strikes with the _heartripper blade_ inflict an additional 1d6 negative damage to living creatures.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You reduce a foe to 0 Hit Points with a Strike from the _heartripper blade_;  **Effect** The _heartripper blade_ draws life from the victim's body and siphons it into you. Choose one of the following effects: restore 2d8 Hit Points; reduce the value of your [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13), or [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) conditions by 1; or reduce the stage of one toxin or [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) you're suffering by one stage (this can't reduce the stage below stage 1 or cure the affliction).

</column>

**Activate—Rally to the cause** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a devotion spell. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it's lost.

**Craft Requirements** You're a champion of the deity represented by the helmet.

</title>

**Base Shield** [Meteor Shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=13)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

This [standard-grade duskwood](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2815) [meteor shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=13) (Hardness 7, HP 28, BT 14) is a wheel from a ship. While wielding the shield, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Sailing Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) and to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;  **Requirements** You're in a body of water; **Effect** For 10 minutes, you don't sink if you haven't succeeded at a Swim action on a turn, and if you're submerged, you automatically ascend 10 feet at the end of your turn.

    right="Item 11"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Hexing Jar](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2324)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 148

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Dangling from a simple cord, a _hexing jar_ houses rich soil. When a [witch](/Classes.aspx?ID=16) who has invested the jar wears it overnight, a miniature thing grows from the soil. Your patron chooses the form, commonly including glowing mushrooms, venus flytraps, mandragora roots, or undead hands reaching up. The thing whispers secrets it learned from your patron, giving you a +2 item bonus to your patron skill.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a witch [hex](/Traits.aspx?ID=324) spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You roll a critical success on an attack roll with a witch spell, or your target rolls a critical failure on its saving throw against a witch spell or hex you cast;  **Effect** The thing in the jar becomes more energetic—glowing, dancing, rapping on the glass, or some other action appropriate to its appearance. It encourages you until the start of your next turn, granting you and your familiar a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws and a +2 status bonus against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effects.

**Craft Requirements** You are a witch.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[High-Contrast Goggles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3248)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 113

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Made with a brightly colored leather strap, these goggles have a series of overlapping lenses in an array of colors spanning the spectrum of visible light. The effect of this is that every color is more vibrant and similar shades have higher contrast. This means that shapes of even similar colors tend to stand out more, allowing the wearer to see even camouflage easier.

As an [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) action, you can set the lenses to make things stand out at your current location. Until you move, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2298) checks when you [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301).

This _[+1](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [klar](/Shields.aspx?ID=12)_ is fashioned from the skull of a hippopotamus, with one of its canines acting as the blade. While wielding a _hippopotamus klar_, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks.

**Activate—Engulfing Jaws** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The hippo jaws of the shield open impossibly wide. Make a melee [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with the klar blade targeting two creatures adjacent to each other. Roll the attack and damage once and apply it to each creature separately. This counts as two attacks for your [multiple attack penalty](/Rules.aspx?ID=2289).

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the entire skull of a [hippopotamus](/Monsters.aspx?ID=699).

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 63

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Hands** 2

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This wooden box unfolds into a stack of hinged trays holding calipers, magnifying lenses, acids and reagents, comparison sketches of species commonly mistaken for one another, and glass slides for specimen testing. When you use this kit to study accounts of a creature or what it left behind (such as spoor, tracks, or fur samples), you gain a +1 item bonus to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about the creature or to [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=66) the creature. In addition, if you fail to Recall Knowledge about the creature (but don't critically fail), you're able to eliminate at least one possibility of a common type of animal. For instance, you might be able to verify the creature isn't an [owlbear](/Monsters.aspx?ID=328), even if you get no further information.

>
[Hongrui's Gratitude](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2684)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 82

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Given as thanks for honoring the memories of three unfortunate travelers who met a tragic end in the Willowshore Hinterlands, this red-hooded cloak is decorated with an image of an elaborately dressed performer whose two companions hold a lantern and umbrella for her.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You don't have the umbrella activation of this cloak active; **Effect** With a wave of the cloak to the left, you cause the image of the lantern-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. A floating red lantern appears at your side and follows you at an arm's length while casting [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 20 feet) like a [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60). For 1 hour, while the light from this lantern is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the torch.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You don't have the lantern activation of this cloak active; **Effect** With a wave of the cloak to the right, you cause the image of the umbrella-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. An indestructible red wax paper umbrella appears above you and follows you, shielding you from weather effects, such as rain or bright sunlight. For 1 hour, while this umbrella is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the umbrella.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 290 **Usage** worn --- Fine silk lines this fashionable pocket, which is typically cinched to a belt or tailored into a piece of formal clothing. The pocket can hold no more than one item of light Bulk, plus incidental items of negligible Bulk. The pocket grants you a +2 item bonus to Society and to Stealth checks to [Conceal an Object](/Actions.aspx?ID=61) in the pocket.
The pocket can produce stationery and writing implements of high quality. When you [Create a Forgery](/Actions.aspx?ID=60), you can use the pocket to produce ideal materials to make the forgery. Any materials must be able to fit through the opening of the pocket, such as a roll of parchment, an inkwell, or a loupe. Though they're excellent tools, they don't have any value if sold and disappear once their function in making a forgery is fulfilled. **Activate—Papers Please** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** You create a temporary forgery by imagining the document you need and pulling it from the pocket. Attempt to [Create a Forgery](/Actions.aspx?ID=60) of the document you desire, with the GM rolling the secret check as normal.     level="1"
    right="Item 4"

>
[Hunter's Arrowhead](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2343)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 153, [Pathfinder #145: Hellknight Hill](/Sources.aspx?ID=4) pg. 77

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _hunter's arrowhead_ is meant to be worn as a charm, such as a pendant, or carried in a pocket or quiver. The arrowhead is etched with images sacred to the elven god [Ketephys](/Deities.aspx?ID=110). While you wear or carry the arrowhead, it infuses you with great skill at hunting, and you gain a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks and attack rolls against any creature you've currently designated as your prey with [Hunt Prey](/Actions.aspx?ID=10). A _hunter's arrowhead_ is also a [religious symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=41) of Ketephys.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You would miss with an attack made with a [bow](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=3);  **Effect** You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll, possibly turning a miss into a hit.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Age of Ashes</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #145: Hellknight Hill](/Sources.aspx?ID=4) pg. 77, [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 153

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Reaction" /><row>command</row></row>

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would miss with an attack made with a bow.

 
</row>

</column>

---

This arrowhead-shaped charm is not meant to be affixed to an arrow, but instead to be carried in a pocket or inside of a quiver. A _hunter’s arrowhead_ is etched with images sacred to the elven god Ketephys. If you carry one on your person, you are infused with great skill at hunting, and gain a +1 item bonus to Survival skill checks and attack rolls against any creature you’ve currently designated as your prey for the [Hunt Prey](/Actions.aspx?ID=10) ranger ability (note that the bonus to attack rolls is an item bonus, and therefore not cumulative with an item bonus from a magic weapon). A _hunter's arrowhead_ is also a religious symbol of Ketephys.

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=528" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Mutagen" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=116" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 110

**Price** 600 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

You sprout a second head, increasing your awareness, intuition, and cognitive ability but also causing your physical capabilities to be impaired as both minds struggle to control a single body.

**Benefit** For 10 minutes, you gain [all-around vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=49) and a +3 item bonus to all Intelligence- and Wisdom-based skill checks. Once during the mutagen's effect, if you fail or critically fail a Will saving throw against a [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effect, you can treat the result as one degree of success better.

**Drawback** You are [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 1 for 10 minutes.

</column>

fields.text: Item 13 Hydra Mutagen Alchemical Consumable Mutagen Polymorph Source Howl of the Wild pg. 110 Price 600 gp Usage held in 1 hand Bulk L Activate Single Action (manipulate) You sprout a second head, increasing your awareness, intuition, and cognitive ability but also causing your physical capabilities to be impaired as both minds struggle to control a single body. Benefit For 10 minutes, you gain all-around vision and a +3 item bonus to all Intelligence- and Wisdom-based skill checks. Once during the mutagen's effect, if you fail or critically fail a Will saving throw against a mental effect, you can treat the result as one degree of success better. Drawback You are clumsy 1 for 10 minutes.

**Price** 500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _illusionist’s hat_ appears as a tall, black hat with a wide brim and a colorful band around its base. Although popularly associated with themes of magic, this hat is more the province of the entertainer or even the charlatan than of a proper arcanist, and many wizards scoff at those who openly wear such items. You gain a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) checks made to [Create a Diversion](/Actions.aspx?ID=2387) and to [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=50) checks made to [Palm an Object](/Actions.aspx?ID=2409). 

**Activate—What's In My Hat?** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** With a flourish, you remove your hat and sweep it before you. The _illusionist’s hat_ casts a 3rd-rank [_illusory creature_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1567) to your specifications, save that the creature created must be an animal. As long as you continue to hold your hat in one hand, you can Sustain this illusion as a free action. Unlike with most illusory creatures, you cannot use your actions to speak through the creature.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.markdown:
**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 291 **Price** 19,000 gp **Usage** worn garment **Bulk** 2 --- This strange and intricate harness fits snugly to the torso. Once you invest the apparatus, numerous artificial limbs with various tools, clamps, and lenses whirl into action, following your mental commands effortlessly.
When using this apparatus, you gain a +3 item bonus to Crafting checks to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=43), [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23), and [Repair](/Actions.aspx?ID=42), and you reduce the minimum time required to Craft an item to 1 day. If you succeed at your Crafting check and spend more downtime to continue work on the item after the minimum number of days, each day you spend reduces the remaining raw material cost by an amount based on your level + 1 and your proficiency rank in Crafting; on a critical success, each day reduces the remaining raw material cost by an amount based on your level + 2 and your proficiency rank. If you are 20th level, on a critical success your progress is 50 gp, 100 gp, 200 gp, or 350 gp for trained, expert, master, or legendary proficiency, respectively. **Activate—Inexplicable Patch** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You command the apparatus to magically jury-rig an item you hold or that's within 5 feet of you. The item is repaired, as a 3rd-rank [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=189) spell. This lasts for 10 minutes, after which the item returns to its previous state of disrepair unless you've Repaired it before then.

    right="Item 9"
    pfs=""
>
[Injigo's Loving Embrace](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3147)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #198: No Breath to Cry](/Sources.aspx?ID=224) pg. 77

**Price** 675 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This net was woven by the jorogumo Injigo, who presented it as a gift to her gnome sweetheart, Mara, to keep her safe in their mountain cottage when Injigo left on hunting expeditions.

 _Injigo's Loving Embrace_ functions as a typical [net](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2738). You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks made to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376) with the net.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You spin the net in the direction of an incorporeal creature within 30 feet that you can see. Lines of silken force whip out to lash around the incorporeal creature, who must attempt a DC 25 Reflex save to avoid becoming [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain this activation for up to 1 minute, and the creature must succeed at a DC 25 check to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) the net.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes (envision, Interact);  **Frequency** once per week;   **Effect** You wrap the net around you like a blanket as you prepare to sleep. As long as you get 8 hours of sleep or analogous rest, you dream of writing love letters to someone you adore: this could be an actual paramour, someone you're interested in, or someone unknown whose identity you don't recall after waking. When you wake, you're filled with a sense of melancholia about those unsent letters, but these feelings distract you from other, more unpleasant thoughts, granting you resistance 5 to mental damage and a +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects for the next 8 hours.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

[Insistent Door Knocker](/Equipment.aspx?ID=511)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 72

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This dark iron door knocker comes in a variety of shapes, such as a bird clutching a ring in its talons or a gargoyle holding a ring in its mouth. Placing the door knocker on the surface of a door (an Interact action) causes it to attach and remain in place. While in place, the door knocker whispers hints to you while you attempt to unlock the door, granting a +1 item bonus to [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) checks to Pick a Lock. Removing the door knocker from a surface requires you to use an Interact action.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You place the door knocker against a wall, floor, or ceiling. The door knocker fuses in place and creates a usable door within the surface. Any creature can move through the door normally, as if the door had always been there. The door can penetrate up to 1 foot of material, so thick material, such as heavy stone walls, can cause this effect to fail, expending its use for the day. A thin layer of metal in a wall, floor, or ceiling also causes the effect to fail. You can use an Interact action to release the door knocker from the surface and return the surface to its previous shape.

>
[Inspiring Spotlight](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3531)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Convocation</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=640" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rival Academies](/Sources.aspx?ID=235) pg. 56, [Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God](/Sources.aspx?ID=23) pg. 73

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

An _inspiring spotlight_ consists of a drum-shaped metal housing around several reflective plates. It has the capacity to cast a powerful, narrow beam of light to illuminate important moments or characters on stage. The portable version consists of an 18-inch-diameter lamp on a tripod that can be set up or broken down over the course of 10 minutes. The mounted version is typically 3 feet in diameter and affixed to a bracket above and behind the audience for indoor performances.

**Activate—Light It Up** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The _inspiring spotlight_ emits a 5-foot burst of bright magical light within 120 feet. If the burst intersects with an area of magical darkness, the _inspiring spotlight_ attempts to counteract the darkness with a +17 modifier. Creatures within the burst gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws and Charisma-based skill checks. The spotlight remains lit for 1 minute or until you Interact to turn it off. During this time any creature adjacent to the spotlight can move the burst up to 20 feet from the burst’s original position with an Interact action.

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Jaathoom's Scarf](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2582)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 75

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn belt

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This scarf is made of fine silk that's the same shade of blue as a clear, cloudless sky. The short ends are edged with a fine gold fringe that seems to sway even in still weather as though touched by invisible winds. The long edges have exquisite embroidery in threads that vary from a blue identical to the silk to the deep gray of storm clouds during winter. Wearing this scarf grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks to dance and to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79).

**Activate—Vanish** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The scarf casts 4th-rank [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) on you.

**Activate—Jaathoom's Rebuke** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You let the winds around you catch the edges of the _jaathoom's scarf_, and a jaathoom shuyookh appears with a sudden updraft. The winds force your enemies back, granting you some breathing room in battle. Each enemy in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save or be [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet. A creature that critically fails is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) after being moved. Creatures with the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5) trait are immune to all these effects.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.item_bonus_note: Games Lore in a dice game using the item
fields.markdown:
**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 99 **Price** 1,800 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand --- _Jabali's dice_ are two six-sided dice carved from evenly weighted stone to the specifications of a specific jabali shuyookh. The sides showing a 6 also have the name and title of the shuyookh inscribed in Petran. If you whisper the name and title during a dice game using _jabali's dice_, they bless you with a bit of luck, granting a +2 item bonus to your [Games Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) check. You can do so frequently enough to apply this bonus while [Earning Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23) using Games Lore, but only one user at a time can do so. **Activate—Jabali's Gamble** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You call out the shuyookh's name and title, then roll the dice. The shuyookh appears briefly to provide for your defense. Roll 2d6 to determine the effect. Represented by the GM, the shuyookh chooses any effect's specifications, benefiting you according to the shuyookh's whims.
**2–5**The shuyookh casts [_mountain resilience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=312) on you.
**6–9**The shuyookh casts [_grasping earth_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1334), but you and your allies are immune to it.
**10–11**The shuyookh casts [_wall of stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=365). The edges can pass through creatures, which are shunted to the side of the wall opposite that edge.
**12**The shuyookh casts a DC 31 [_petrify_](/Spells.aspx?ID=123) spell on a creature hostile and in proximity to you. If no appealing target exists, you receive a 10–11 result instead.

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Jann's Prism](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2655)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 224

**Price** 700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Light always seems to be refracting through this simple prism, creating a hazy multicolor aura that surrounds the glass. When exposed to direct sunlight, the prism radiates a beam of light that shifts in color. This beam spells out the name of the jann shuyookh for whom the prism was designed. While holding the prism to your eye, your vision becomes overwhelmed with colors that guide your eye, granting you a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks. If you look through the prism while you Seek, you can scan or search an area twice as large as normal (a 60-foot cone, 30-foot burst, or 20-foot square) as the varying colors help you distinguish between your surroundings.

**Activate—Jann's Light** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You raise the prism above your head and call upon the jann shuyookh to come to your aid. The shuyookh's face becomes visible in a reflection in the prism and light shines out from the prism, surrounding you in a multitude of colors. For 1 minute, you shed [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot emanation (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 20 feet). The light coruscates with two colors chosen by the jann, and you gain resistance 5 to two damage types based on the colors chosen: **red** [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), **orange** [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3), **yellow** [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), **green** [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), **blue** [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147), **indigo** [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), or **violet** [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Jaws of the Grogrisant](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3780)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Shining Kingdoms](/Sources.aspx?ID=265) pg. 173

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn circlet

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The teeth that fell off the [_Mantle of the Grogrisant_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1476) were given to the scholars of Houses Fahlspar, Lotheed, Nicodemius, and Zespire, who—after much heated discussion—created this regal circlet. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) and [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) skill checks and [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=2302) checks against creatures that have the [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676) trait. When you invest in the headband, you either increase your Wisdom modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate—Primal Empathy** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You gain the ability to communicate with nature as if you were a part of it. You cast [_telepathy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1719) at 6th rank, which can only be used to communicate with creatures that have the [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676) trait.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 186

**Price** 55 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These [thieves' tools](/Equipment.aspx?ID=58) provide their owner the ability to have continued control over a lock while leaving it in place. They grant a +1 item bonus to [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) checks to [Pick a Lock](/Actions.aspx?ID=70). Upon completely opening a lock by picking it with these tools, the tools produce a temporary copy of the key for the picked lock. This phantom key can lock or unlock the lock just like the original key. The key appears attached to the thieves' tools case by a fine silver chain and lasts for 12 hours before it fades into nothing. Only one key created this way can exist in the same set of thieves' tools. Creating a new key replaces the previous one.

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</column>

---

These elevated wooden sandals once belonged to a haughty kitsune named Kinburi. It was well known that her swiftness and grace were unmatched, and observers described her as seeming to glide above the earth with each step. She often challenged others to wager on her speed, but as people began to grow wise, she was forced to conceal her identity or promise to forfeit her sandals if she lost.

 These sandals give you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to [High Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=2377) and [Long Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=2378). In addition, when you use the [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=2298) action, you can move 5 feet further if jumping horizontally or 3 feet higher if jumping vertically.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> (command);  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You loudly boast about your grace and agility, then take any combination of two High Jumps or Long Jumps. You do not need to Stride first, and between the two jumps, you need only to come into contact with a physical object before making the second jump; this object doesn't need to be one that can bear your weight, or even be attached to the ground—you can jump off from a floating feather or a thin branch or even off a paper wall as needed. The sandals' item bonus increases to +2 for these jumps.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A krasovnatype (named after Dr. Krasovna Gerenevich) consists of a carefully prepared silvered glass plate charged by a Stasian coil. When you touch the front of the glass or hold it near a living creature within your reach, an image of that creature’s aura is imprinted on the glass. Once a krasovnatype has an image on it, you can’t use the glass plate on another creature. If you are trained in Occultism, you can look at the image and learn if the associated creature has innate, prepared, or spontaneous spellcasting, along with the tradition of that casting and the highest rank of spells they can cast. Referencing the image grants a +1 item bonus to any [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) check regarding the creature.

This display generates a pulse of energy in a 30-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) from you. **Failure** The creature takes 5d8 vitality damage; if the creature has the [ghost](/Traits.aspx?ID=753) trait, it becomes [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 for 1 minute.

>
[Laurel of the Empath](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2139)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Fortune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=76" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 103

**Price** 70,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn circlet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This silvery, woven ring of leaves sits on top of the head. While wearing it, when you roll Perception for initiative, you can roll twice and take the higher result. This is a fortune effect. Whenever you spend at least 1 minute talking with a living creature, you automatically become aware of its attitude toward you. When you invest the laurel, you either increase your Wisdom modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per minute; **Trigger** You're hit by an attack;  **Effect** You take half damage from the triggering attack.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You fail, but don't critically fail, a saving throw;  **Effect** You anticipate the danger and guard against it, often in unconventional or almost inconceivable ways. Treat the failed saving throw as a success.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=612), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You spend 10 minutes talking with one living creature, conversing in inspirational, religious, or philosophical terms. You gain valuable insights into the personality of your target—their hopes, dreams, and fears. When the ritual is over, you gain a +4 item bonus to all Perception checks made concerning the target for one month. Also, the target gains inspirational insight, allowing the target to use one of the two reactions listed above once during the next 24 hours.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

The swirls on this wooden mask—often worn by Mordant Censors—move and shift, reflecting the shape of the nearest currents. Wearing the mask grants you a +1 item bonus to [Sailing Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=41) and [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) checks. In addition, it allows you to pilot a boat with simply a thought. When you pilot a vehicle, you can keep both hands free and [Drive](/Actions.aspx?ID=3517) from any location on the vehicle. 

**Activate—Set the Course** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You are aboard a vehicle; **Effect** You become [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=89) for 1 minute or until you leave the vehicle, whichever comes first, and can use the extra action to [Take Control](/Actions.aspx?ID=3520) of the vehicle or, if you’re already piloting it, Drive or [Stop](/Actions.aspx?ID=3519) the vehicle.

---

This wide leather belt grants you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks and increases the amount you can easily carry. You can carry Bulk equal to 6 + your Strength modifier before becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 11 + your Strength modifier. 

**Activate—Assisted Lift** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You lift an object of up to 8 Bulk as though it were weightless. This requires two hands, and if the object is locked or otherwise held in place, you can attempt to Force it Open using Athletics as part of this activation. The object still has its full weight and Bulk for all other purposes—you just ignore that weight. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=89" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 64

**Price** 160 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Leaf Weave](/Armor.aspx?ID=28)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This suit of [leaf weave](/Armor.aspx?ID=28) armor is specially modified to metabolize the alchemical accelerants in medicinal compounds. A special receptacle in the armor can hold an [elixir of life](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3308), which takes 3 Interact actions to install.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** An elixir of life is installed in the armor; **Effect** Slithering vines grow from the armor, granting an item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376), to your Fortitude DC to resist Grapple, [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=2383), or [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380) attempts, and to your Reflex DC to resist Trip attempts. The bonus is equal to the elixir’s item bonus, and lasts for 3 rounds. The activation uses up the elixir, and the armor can’t be activated again until a new one is installed.

</row>

---

This suit of [leaf weave armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=28) is specially modified to metabolize the alchemical accelerants in medicinal compounds. A special receptacle in the armor can hold an [elixir of life](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3308), which takes 3 [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) actions to install. A loaded suit of living leaf weave can be activated to grow slithering vines from the armor, granting an item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks to Grapple, to your Fortitude DC to resist [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376), [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=2383), or [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380) attempts, and to your Reflex DCs to resist Trip attempts. The effects last for 3 rounds, consuming the elixir of life, and once the reaction has begun it can’t be deactivated.

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</column>

---

A nigh-infinite assortment of games exist in Golarion. Simple games, including dice, a deck of cards, or dominoes, cost 5 sp. Board games vary in cost from 1 gp for dexterity games like Bungle, 3 gp for colorful children's games like Cauldron Quest, and 5 gp for complex strategy games like Kingmaker and Abendego Raiders. Lavish game sets can cost much more than these prices, as they are made of expensive components and are intricately crafted works of art unto themselves.

<row gap="medium">

---

These dice are weighted on one side to ensure they always land with the desired number facing up. Loaded dice grant you a +1 item bonus to [Games Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) checks to gamble with the dice. You can determine a die is loaded while handling it with a successful secret DC 20 Perception check. Determining dice are loaded without handling the dice is more difficult, especially since smart cheaters switch loaded dice in and out so they don't suspiciously roll the same number over and over. In this case, an observer must succeed at a secret Perception check against the roller's Games Lore or [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) DC to notice the switches or the patterns.

fields.text: Item 1 Loaded Dice Source NPC Core pg. 26 Price 5 gp Usage held in 2 hands Bulk L These dice are weighted on one side to ensure they always land with the desired number facing up. Loaded dice grant you a +1 item bonus to Games Lore checks to gamble with the dice. A creature can determine a die is loaded while handling it with a successful secret DC 20 Perception check. Determining dice are loaded without handling the dice is more difficult, especially since smart cheaters switch loaded dice in and out so they don't suspiciously roll the same number over and over. In this case, an observer must succeed at a secret Perception check against the roller's Games Lore or Thievery DC to notice the switches or the patterns.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 2"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Lookout's Spyglass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5218)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Dead God's Hand</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143

**Price** 35 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This brass and wood [spyglass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2754) is typically decorated with etchings of distant landscapes seen on the horizon of a vast body of water. When the spyglass is extended for use, the etchings of distant-appearing horizons appear to grow closer. A _lookout's spyglass_ can be used as a typical spyglass to see eight times farther than normal, but it also has the following activation.

**Activate—Seek Significance** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You spend a minute observing your surroundings in all directions through the _lookout's spyglass_, taking in the features of the terrain while the spyglass sharpens your senses of observation. Once you complete the activation, the next time within the next hour that you roll Perception for initiative, you gain a +1 item bonus on the roll if you're still carrying the _lookout's spyglass_ on your person.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Emotion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=590" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 292

**Price** 500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn gloves

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These white silk gloves are adorned in red hearts that glow faintly whenever you are adjacent to someone you feel particularly strongly toward. They buoy your spirit, giving you a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks. 

**Activate—Bond** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You grasp the hands of a willing creature you have strong positive feelings about, regardless of the nature of those feelings. The creature gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws and 10 temporary Hit Points for 10 minutes. If the creature shares your feelings, you gain the same benefits, and for the duration, when you both roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect that causes negative emotions, you both get a critical success instead.

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 70

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All Pathfinder Society agents also have access to all assistive items from Morhen’s Mobility Apparel_

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** 6
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

A _maestro's chair_ is a [traveler's chair](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1356) with the [impulse control](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1361) upgrade and a small pipe organ installed into the frame. You can use the maestro's chair to make [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks in the same manner that you could use any mundane instrument, using both of your hands. When you make a Performance check using your chair, you gain a +1 item bonus to the check.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per 10 minutes;   **Effect** You use your chair to Stride up to your chair's speed. If you have a [composition](/Traits.aspx?ID=31) cantrip that is currently active, you Sustain it as a free action.

</column>

    level="1"
    right="Item 5"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Magnetic Shield](/Equipment.aspx?ID=4512)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Aura" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=206" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 64

**Price** 130 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Shield** [Steel Shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=19)
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Copper rings spiral around this [steel shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=19). Twin electrical probes near the grip can socket into a jar of moderate (or higher leveled) [bottled lightning](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3290), which takes 3 [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) actions to install. A loaded magnetic shield can be activated to convert it into an electromagnet. When an activated magnetic shield is raised, the circumstance bonus increases by 1 against attacks made with weapons primarily made of metal. If you use a [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=5212) against a creature attacking you with such a weapon, you also gain a +1 item bonus to [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=2383) attempts against that weapon until the end of your next turn. The shield remains charged for 3 rounds, consuming the bottled lightning, and once the reaction has begun it can’t be deactivated.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 9+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Magnetite Scope](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1213)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 181

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Characters with access to firearms gain access to accessories that can be used with those weapons._

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** attached to firearm (scope)

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

More of a field projector than a scope, this small cylinder of magnetite has been enchanted to spread and accelerate the shrapnel of a [scatter](/Traits.aspx?ID=413) weapon further than the weapon's natural capabilities. Furthermore, some of the floating magnetite inside the scope's structure can help you when attempting to determine the your allies' locations. The magnetite scope grants you a +2 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks to [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=64) when using the scope to assist you in navigating. This scope can only be attached to firearms with the scatter trait.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** The next Strike you make this round with the gun to which the scope is attached has its scatter radius increased by 5 feet.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The item bonus is +3, and activating the scope increases the scatter radius by 10 feet.
