<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Possibility Tome](/Equipment.aspx?ID=262)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 574

**Price** 22,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

An array of semiprecious stones is set into the ornate silver and beaten copper cover of this thick and weighty tome. If you open the book before it’s been activated, its vellum pages are blank and pristine, but once activated, words dance and swim onto the pages before your eyes.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes (envision, Interact);     **Effect** As you flip through the book, you think about a broad topic you want to know more about. Choose one skill: Arcana, Crafting, Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Religion, Society, or a single subcategory of Lore. The book’s pages fill with information about that skill, though only you can see the information. While the pages are full, you can spend an Interact action perusing the book just before attempting a check to Recall Knowledge with the chosen skill. This grants you a +3 item bonus to the check, and if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. The information within the book disappears after 24 hours or when the tome is activated again.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

An array of semiprecious stones is set into the ornate silver and beaten copper cover of this thick and weighty tome. If you open the book before it’s been activated, its vellum pages are blank and pristine, but once activated, words dance and swim onto the pages before your eyes.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes (envision, Interact);     **Effect** As you flip through the book, you think about a broad topic you want to know more about. Choose one skill: Arcana, Crafting, Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Religion, Society, or a single subcategory of Lore. The book’s pages fill with information about that skill, though only you can see the information. While the pages are full, you can spend an Interact action perusing the book just before attempting a check to Recall Knowledge with the chosen skill. This grants you a +3 item bonus to the check, and if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. The information within the book disappears after 24 hours or when the tome is activated again.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 7"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Powered Full Plate](/Equipment.aspx?ID=4515)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 65

**Price** 360 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 4
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Full Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=50)
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Stasian actuators help the limbs of this [full plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=50) move of their own accord, as long as they’re supplied with power. A chamber in the chest plate can hold a single [bottled lightning](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3290), which takes 3 [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) actions to install. A loaded suit of powered full plate can be activated to lower the armor’s Strength requirement by 1 plus the item bonus of the loaded bomb. The armor’s normal penalties still apply, based on this altered Strength. However, add the bottled lightning’s item bonus to your [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks to [Force Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=2375), [High Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=2377), [Long Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=2378), and [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380). These effects last for 10 minutes. The armor uses up the bottled lightning during the duration and can’t be activated again until a new one is installed.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 6+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Primeval Mistletoe](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3100)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 294

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This sprig of berry-festooned holly and mistletoe doesn't wilt or rot. It can be used as a primal locus, and it grants a +1 item bonus to Nature checks while you wear it. 

**Activate—Anoint** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per 10 minutes;   **Effect** You squeeze juice from one of the berries and smear it onto a weapon made primarily of wood to cast [_runic weapon_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1658) on it, or onto a creature to cast [_runic body_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1657) on it. 

**Activate—Bind** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch the sprig, then a tree to cast [_one with plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1618) upon yourself, turning into a vine on the touched tree.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Primeval Mistletoe
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 294, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 574

**Price** 230 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 14"
pfs="Standard"
>
Primeval Mistletoe (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 294, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 574

**Price** 3,900 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The sprig grants a +2 item bonus to Nature checks, the spell from Anoint is heightened to 6th rank, and the sprig can be activated in one additional way:

**Activate—Cultivate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You plant the _greater primeval mistletoe_ into an area of natural earth or stone. Once planted, the plant immediately sprouts into an area of holly bushes that don't impede movement and that pulse with vitality energy, replicating the effects of a [_field of life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=114) spell. You can Sustain the activation up to 1 minute. When this magic ends, the holly bushes revert back into the original _greater primeval mistletoe_.

</title>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 310

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

This gauzy purple veil is embroidered with symbols of divinatory significance. As your curse worsens, the veil ripples in an ever-increasing unseen wind. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46) checks.

**Activate—Remember the Future** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a revelation spell. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it's lost.

**Activate—Twist the Skeins of Fate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** oncer per day; **Trigger** An ally within 30 feet is about to attempt a saving throw; **Requirements** You have the [cursebound](/Traits.aspx?ID=320) condition; **Effect** The ally gains a status bonus to the saving throw equal to the value of your cursebound condition. 

**Craft Requirements** You're an oracle.

May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts **Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 77 **Price** 1,820 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L **Base Weapon** [Staff](/Weapons.aspx?ID=12) --- This ash wood staff is topped by a long tassel of bleached-white horsehair. Historically carried by the most important of court officials throughout various regions and periods of Tian Xia's history, purgatory emissary's staves are also strongly associated with psychopomps serving punitive sentences. It's thought this connection is a comical nod to the bureaucratic nature of the afterlife. Psychopomps and spirits tend to regard you with a level of respect while you carry a _purgatory emissary's staff_. While you wield this staff, you receive a +2 item bonus to all skill checks made to adjust a psychopomp's or spirit's attitude. When used as a weapon, a purgatory emissary's staff is a _+2 striking [ghost touch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2840) [staff](/Weapons.aspx?ID=367)_. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
  • **Cantrip** [_disrupt undead_](/Spells.aspx?ID=79)
  • **1st** [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1470), [_sanctuary_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1660)
  • **2nd** [_remove fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=252), [_see invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=271)
  • **3rd** [_searing light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=269), [_zone of truth_](/Spells.aspx?ID=379)
  • **4th** [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1493), [_talking corpse_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1712)
  • **5th** [_banishment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1448), [_tongues_](/Spells.aspx?ID=340)

<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 50

**Price** 30 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _quick wig_ magically conceals your natural hair while worn, eliminating the need to braid or pin your hair beneath it. In addition, your facial hair and eyebrows change color to match the wig while you wear it. When used as part of a [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) check to [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46) to go unrecognized by changing your hair, you no longer require a [disguise kit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=19), you gain a +1 item bonus on the check, and you reduce the time to create the disguise from 10 minutes to 5 minutes. You still need a disguise kit and the full time if you're using cosmetics and other props to change other aspects of your disguise or Impersonating a specific person, and the wig only provides its item bonus when Impersonating a specific person if that person's hair color and style match the wig's. _Quick wigs_ detangle themselves while not in use.

</column>

>
Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 617

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All Pathfinders have access._

**Price** 28 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called [_aeon stones_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407). It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. A _wayfinder_ functions as a compass.

 An indentation in the middle of the _wayfinder_ can hold a single _aeon stone_. Placing an _aeon stone_ in this indentation provides you all the benefits of having the _aeon stone_ orbiting your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest a _wayfinder_ and the _aeon stone_ within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your investiture limit. An invested _aeon stone_ slotted in a _wayfinder_ also grants its resonant power.

 If you have more than one _wayfinder_ with an invested _aeon stone_ on your person at a given time, destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional _aeon stones_ orbiting your head, just not in _wayfinders_.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;     **Effect** The _wayfinder_ is targeted by a 1st-level [_light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=171) spell.

</row>

<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="" /><row>Cast a Spell</row></row>

---

An _archaic wayfinder_ functions as a compass and acts as a repository for one cantrip cast into it. To fill an _archaic wayfinder_, a spellcaster casts the chosen cantrip into the empty device, providing any necessary cost; the spell cannot be one that is normally cast as a free action or reaction. Activating an _archaic wayfinder_ is the same as the casting for the relevant spell. Once it has been activated, it becomes empty again. An _archaic wayfinder_ can hold an aeon stone and activate its resonant power. An _archaic wayfinder_ counts against the limit of one _wayfinder_ with a slotted resonant _[aeon stone](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407)_.

As a standard _wayfinder_, but once per day you can activate it to cast _[heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)_ on a creature other than yourself, using either the one-action or two-action version of _[heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)_ as a 1st-level spell.

Bi-Resonant Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

---

A _bi-resonant wayfinder_ is inlaid with intricate platinum wires in a complex array of conduits for magical energy. These conduits control the resonant interference of _aeon stones_. A _bi-resonant wayfinder_ works just like a regular _wayfinder_ except it has two _aeon stone_ slots, and the _aeon stones_ in both slots grant their resonant powers without interfering with each other. The _bi-resonant wayfinder_ and the two _aeon stones_ count as two items toward your investiture limit.

A _shining wayfinder_ is a polished silver compass blessed by the power of benevolent deities. It has the usual functions of a _wayfinder_, except instead of an activation to cast _light_, the shining wayfinder has the following two activations.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;     **Effect** You hold the _wayfinder_ and ask for guidance. The wayfinder casts [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) on you.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You call upon the wayfinder’s divine blessings for yourself and your allies. The wayfinder casts [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=25), with an emanation centered on itself. Once per turn, you can use a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait, to increase the emanation’s radius by 5 feet.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You turn the _wayfinder_ in a circle while invoking its command word, gaining the effects of a 2nd-level [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) spell for 5 minutes.

---

_Chronicler wayfinders_ bear a mystical connection to the _Pathfinder Chronicles_ themselves, granting them the ability to assist in situations where unusual lore is needed by drawing on lore from a particular topic. Each _chronicler wayfinder_ is attuned to a specific [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill, chosen at the time of creation. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a chronicler wayfinder has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** You tap into the _Pathfinder Chronicles_ on the _chronicler wayfinder's_ attuned topic, gaining the effects of a [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) action with the chosen Lore skill. For the Lore check's modifier, use whichever is better of +12 or your own modifier, using your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained in the attuned Lore skill.

Worn on a chain around the neck, a _Razmiri wayfinder_ functions as a [compass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=16) and provides its wearer a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=47) or [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46). _Razmiri wayfinders_ can also be used to grant temporary healing, making it easier for the wearer to impersonate a divine spellcaster.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** three times per day;   **Effect** You touch an adjacent creature, granting them 3d8 temporary Hit Points for 1 hour.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> manipulate;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch an adjacent creature and attempt a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check against one [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) or [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) afflicting the creature. On a success, you halt the effects of the poison or disease for 1 day, rather than removing it. This temporarily relieves any penalties imposed by the affliction but doesn't cure the effect or count against its duration; the poison or disease is merely halted for a time, and it resumes where it left off once this effect ends.

Additionally, you can cast [_feather fall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=111) as a primal innate spell once every 10 minutes.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _wayfinder_ casts a 4th-level [_lightning bolt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=172).

_Fashionable wayfinders_ allow you to be dressed for success in almost any situation. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a _fashionable wayfinder_ can attune to up to three sets of mundane clothing in your possession during your daily preparations. A _fashionable wayfinder_ has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** You call one of the attuned sets of clothing onto yourself, changing clothes instantly and leaving you either holding the old set of clothing or with the old set folded neatly on the floor if you don't have a free hand to hold it. This activation can't change you into or out of a suit of armor of any kind. While the activation can transport the chosen attuned set of clothing onto you from up to 60 feet away, it can't transport any other creatures or items that might have been stored in the clothing.

_Homeward wayfinders_ are powerful escape tools in the hands of a Pathfinder agent, drawing upon a special connection to the Maze of the Open Road. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a _homeward wayfinder_ attunes itself to the most recent Pathfinder Lodge you've visited and has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes (command, Interact);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You teleport back to the attuned Pathfinder Lodge, as long as you are no more than 100 miles away. This [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=156) effect fails if you would bring another creature with you, even if you're carrying it in an [extradimensional](/Traits.aspx?ID=67) space.

_Hummingbird wayfinders_ blend a few Arcadian secrets into the original _wayfinder_ design, allowing the _wayfinder_ to gain mobility for a time and act as a spy. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a _hummingbird wayfinder_ has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You cause the _wayfinder_ to transform into a Tiny bee hummingbird, only 2 inches long. Other than the _wayfinder_ being a visible bird, this has the effects of [_prying eye_](/Spells.aspx?ID=239). In addition to [Seeking](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) through the hummingbird, you can activate any [_aeon stone_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407) within the _wayfinder_ as if the _wayfinder_ were still on your person. When the effect ends, the _wayfinder_ transforms back to normal in its current position. Damaging the bird ends the effect but does not destroy the _wayfinder_.

Each chronicler wayfinder is attuned to a specific Lore skill, chosen at the time of creation. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a chronicler wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Single Action envision; Effect You tap into the Pathfinder Chronicles on the chronicler wayfinder's attuned topic, gaining the effects of a Recall Knowledge action with the chosen Lore skill. For the Lore check's modifier, use whichever is better of +12 or your own modifier, using your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained in the attuned Lore skill. Item 10 Razmiri Wayfinder Uncommon Illusion Magical Necromancy Source PFS Guide pg. 72 Price 900 gp Usage worn Worn on a chain around the neck, a Razmiri wayfinder functions as a compass and provides its wearer a +1 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie or Impersonate. Razmiri wayfinders can also be used to grant temporary healing, making it easier for the wearer to impersonate a divine spellcaster. Activate Single Action envision; Frequency three times per day; Effect You touch an adjacent creature, granting them 3d8 temporary Hit Points for 1 hour. Activate Single Action manipulate; Frequency once per day; Effect You touch an adjacent creature and attempt a counteract check against one poison or disease afflicting the creature. On a success, you halt the effects of the poison or disease for 1 day, rather than removing it. This temporarily relieves any penalties imposed by the affliction but doesn't cure the effect or count against its duration; the poison or disease is merely halted for a time, and it resumes where it left off once this effect ends. Item 9 Elemental Wayfinder (Air) Uncommon Air Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 650 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you can cast feather fall as a primal innate spell once every 10 minutes. Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level lightning bolt . Item 9 Elemental Wayfinder (Earth) Uncommon Earth Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 600 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you dig twice as quickly as normal. Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level stoneskin . Item 9 Elemental Wayfinder (Fire) Uncommon Evocation Fire Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 700 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain resistance 5 to fire. Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level fireball . Item 10 Elemental Wayfinder (Water) Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Water Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 900 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain the constant effects of water breathing . Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level hydraulic torrent . Item 3 Fashionable Wayfinder Uncommon Conjuration Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 50 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Fashionable wayfinders allow you to be dressed for success in almost any situation. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a fashionable wayfinder can attune to up to three sets of mundane clothing in your possession during your daily preparations. A fashionable wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Single Action envision; Effect You call one of the attuned sets of clothing onto yourself, changing clothes instantly and leaving you either holding the old set of clothing or with the old set folded neatly on the floor if you don't have a free hand to hold it. This activation can't change you into or out of a suit of armor of any kind. While the activation can transport the chosen attuned set of clothing onto you from up to 60 feet away, it can't transport any other creatures or items that might have been stored in the clothing. Item 13 Homeward Wayfinder Uncommon Conjuration Evocation Invested Magical Teleportation Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 2,750 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Homeward wayfinders are powerful escape tools in the hands of a Pathfinder agent, drawing upon a special connection to the Maze of the Open Road. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a homeward wayfinder attunes itself to the most recent Pathfinder Lodge you've visited and has the following activation. Activate 10 minutes (command, Interact); Frequency once per day; Effect You teleport back to the attuned Pathfinder Lodge, as long as you are no more than 100 miles away. This teleportation effect fails if you would bring another creature with you, even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional space. Item 12 Hummingbird Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Transmutation Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 1,750 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Hummingbird wayfinders blend a few Arcadian secrets into the original wayfinder design, allowing the wayfinder to gain mobility for a time and act as a spy. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a hummingbird wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per hour; Effect You cause the wayfinder to transform into a Tiny bee hummingbird, only 2 inches long. Other than the wayfinder being a visible bird, this has the effects of prying eye . In addition to Seeking through the hummingbird, you can activate any aeon stone within the wayfinder as if the wayfinder were still on your person. When the effect ends, the wayfinder transforms back to normal in its current position. Damaging the bird ends the effect but does not destroy the wayfinder .

Wrapped around the head, the stripes almost evoke the patterns of sugi branches coiled around the wearer’s skull. The resolute mind wrap grants you mental [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5.

If you succeed at this saving throw, the resistance to mental damage granted by the _resolute mind wrap_ increases to 10 for 1 minute.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Resonant Guitar](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2616)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
<trait label="Sonic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=147" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 146

**Price** 1,850 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Every part of this dark, shining guitar, from the strings to the soundboard, is constructed of metal. When the strings are strummed, the gilding on the guitar ripples like a liquid. A _resonant guitar_ is a [virtuoso handheld musical instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=37) that grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks attempted while using it.

 A _resonant guitar_ is a planar key for [_interplanar teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) and similar magic to travel to the [Plane of Metal](/Planes.aspx?ID=24). When using it in this way, you can play a tune inspired by your destination to make it more likely to arrive where you intend to be, appearing 1d6×25 miles from your intended destination instead of 1d10×25 miles away.

**Activate—Strum of Thunder** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You play a magnetic tune, enchanting one metallic weapon within 60 feet of you. This item gains the [_thundering_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=306) rune for 1 hour.

**Activate—Chord of Protection** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A creature within 30 feet of you targets you or an ally with a melee attack;  **Effect** You strike a piercing chord, putting up an invisible sound barrier between the target and the attacker. The target gains a +2 status bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the Strike still hits, the barrier breaks, dealing 3d10 sonic damage to the attacker.

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 14"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rhyton of the Radiant Ifrit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2607)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 124

**Price** 4,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This exquisite, shimmering rhyton is made from volcanic glass and encrusted with rubies, garnets, and other red gemstones, with a blown glass sculpture of a snakelike fire elemental at its base. It was sculpted as part of a 10-piece set of drinking horns, created to match a powerful ifrit shuyookh's entertaining dinnerware, but it became separated from the rest of the collection. Whether for good or ill, the beautiful glass rhyton still carries tidings from its previous shuyookh owner, and you become their esteemed guest from afar whenever you hold it.

 The drinking horn functions as a [bottomless stein](/Equipment.aspx?ID=563), refilling with a common ale each time it's emptied. However, anyone holding the rhyton who whispers the name of its former shuyookh owner has the horn filled with their favorite wine, spirit, juice, or other beverage from anywhere across the many planes, as if their wish were granted by a magnanimous genie.

**Activate—Toast!** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You raise a toast to a creature or creatures you're about to socialize with. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5), [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6), or [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks against those creatures for 1 hour.

**Activate—Ifrit's Command** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** An ifrit's hospitality always comes with an implied threat. You cause the shuyookh to briefly appear and take its vengeance on those who would hurt you, the genie's “guest.” The shuyookh issues a 6th-rank [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=45) that targets all creatures [hostile](/Conditions.aspx?ID=23) to you in range instead of the usual number of targets. The shuyookh issues the same command to all of them. Each target that fails its save also feels all nourishment leached from it, becoming [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15) as long as it's affected by the _command_.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Hellbreakers</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers](/Sources.aspx?ID=307) pg. 212

**Price** 35 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

While the Kalistocrats of Druma profiteer off selling weapons to both Hellbreakers and Hellknights, they also offer options suitable for intelligence and counterintelligence efforts. This white gold ring grants you a +1 item bonus to skill checks to [Decipher Writing](/Actions.aspx?ID=2363) that's primarily numerical or mathematical in nature as well as to skill checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392) and [Coerce](/Actions.aspx?ID=2394) to convince others of the fairness or accuracy of your judgments.

**Activate—Fair Assessment** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The Prophecies of Kalistrade reveal the secrets of wealth to you; this appears as a balance sheet of numbers only you can see. Choose an area of up to 1 cubic foot within 30 feet; you can estimate the value in gold pieces of any items within this area. If you attempt to estimate the value of items worn or held by a creature, you must succeed at a Society check to [Decipher Writing](/Actions.aspx?ID=2363) against their Will DC.

---

This magic ring seems like simple tarnished brass, but it enhances your curiosity about traps and devices of all kinds. You can use an Interact action to pull a [thieves' toolkit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2758) from the ring. This toolkit appears in your hand and any part of it folds back into the ring if they would leave your possession. They grant you a +2 item bonus to Thievery checks to [Disable a Device](/Actions.aspx?ID=2411) and to [Pick a Lock](/Actions.aspx?ID=2412), and the ring's insights grant you the same bonus to Crafting checks to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=2385) and [Repair](/Actions.aspx?ID=2384) snares and traps.

**Activate—Fireball Trap** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You create the effects of a [_rune trap_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=124) ritual containing [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1530). You can have only one trapped rune from a ring of maniacal devices active at a time, even if you have multiple rings, and the rune disappears if you lose your investiture in the ring.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 5+"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Ring of the Tiger](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1750)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Kingmaker</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Kingmaker Adventure Path](/Sources.aspx?ID=150) pg. 589

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This ring, carved from green wood, bears carvings of tigers chasing each other through grasslands and forests. _Rings of the tiger_ are traditionally crafted by Kellids in northeastern Avistan, and are often worn by scouts or explorers. Many barbarians in these regions react poorly to anyone obviously not part of their people who dare to wear such a ring, but ironically have been known to gift these rings to outsiders who have proven their worth—potentially setting up a further clash in the future should that character encounter another group of Kellids who aren't familiar with how the wearer earned the right to wear the ring. A ring of the tiger grants a +1 item bonus on [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks and Perception checks made in outdoor wilderness areas, and it can be activated to momentarily transform the wearer's hand into a tiger's claw.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;    **Requirements** You aren't carrying anything in the hand on which the ring is worn; **Effect** Your hand becomes a tiger's claw, granting you an [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170) claw [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) attack that inflicts 1d6 slashing damage, and you Strike with the claw. Then the claw turns back to normal.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

Many barbarians in these regions react poorly to anyone obviously not part of their people who dare to wear such a ring, but ironically have been known to gift these rings to outsiders who have proven their worth—potentially setting up a further clash in the future should that character encounter another group of Kellids who aren't familiar with how the wearer earned the right to wear the ring. A ring of the tiger grants a +1 item bonus on Stealth checks and Perception checks made in outdoor wilderness areas, and it can be activated to momentarily transform the wearer's hand into a tiger's claw. </title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Kingmaker</spoilers>

---

This ring, carved from green wood, bears carvings of tigers chasing each other through grasslands and forests. _Rings of the tiger_ are traditionally crafted by Kellids in northeastern Avistan, and are often worn by scouts or explorers. Many barbarians in these regions react poorly to anyone obviously not part of their people who dare to wear such a ring, but ironically have been known to gift these rings to outsiders who have proven their worth—potentially setting up a further clash in the future should that character encounter another group of Kellids who aren't familiar with how the wearer earned the right to wear the ring. A ring of the tiger grants a +1 item bonus on [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks and Perception checks made in outdoor wilderness areas, and it can be activated to momentarily transform the wearer's hand into a tiger's claw.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;    **Requirements** You aren't carrying anything in the hand on which the ring is worn; **Effect** Your hand becomes a tiger's claw, granting you an [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170) claw [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) attack that inflicts 1d6 slashing damage, and you Strike with the claw. Then the claw turns back to normal.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 7+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Ring of Wizardry](/Equipment.aspx?ID=462)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Arcane" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=11" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 615

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This ring is made from the purest platinum and is covered in esoteric arcane symbols. It does nothing unless you have a spellcasting class feature with the arcane tradition. While wearing the _ring of wizardry_, you gain a +1 item bonus to Arcana checks and have two additional 1st-level arcane spell slots each day. You prepare spells in these slots or cast from them spontaneously, just as you normally cast your spells.

 If you take off the ring for any reason, you lose the additional spell slots. You can’t gain spell slots from more than one _ring of wizardry_ per day, nor can a single _ring of wizardry_ grant spell slots more than once per day.

 If you can cast arcane spells in a variety of different ways (such as if you are a [draconic bloodline sorcerer](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=5) with the [wizard multiclass archetype](/Feats.aspx?ID=742)), you can divide the spell slots as you wish among your various sources of arcane spells.

**Craft Requirements** You have a spellcasting class feature with the arcane tradition.

</column>

This ring is made from the purest platinum and is covered in esoteric arcane symbols. It does nothing unless you have a spellcasting class feature with the arcane tradition. While wearing the _ring of wizardry_, you gain a +1 item bonus to Arcana checks and have two additional 1st-level arcane spell slots each day. You prepare spells in these slots or cast from them spontaneously, just as you normally cast your spells.

 If you take off the ring for any reason, you lose the additional spell slots. You can’t gain spell slots from more than one _ring of wizardry_ per day, nor can a single _ring of wizardry_ grant spell slots more than once per day.

 If you can cast arcane spells in a variety of different ways (such as if you are a [draconic bloodline sorcerer](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=5) with the [wizard multiclass archetype](/Feats.aspx?ID=742)), you can divide the spell slots as you wish among your various sources of arcane spells.

**Craft Requirements** You have a spellcasting class feature with the arcane tradition.

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 203 **Price** 14,000 gp **Usage** worn garment **Bulk** L **Base Armor** [Explorer's Clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=39) --- This soft, buttery smooth robe is _[+2 greater resilient ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2804) [explorer’s clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=39)_ made from silk and [unicorn](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3223) hair. The back and shoulders are appliquéd with clusters of angel feathers to form a motif of unfurled wings. On this robe are subtle arabesques, loops, and curlicues that are pleasing to the eye and evoke a sense of calm. When you wear this robe, you gain an [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83) aura of purity and kindness that extends from you in a 30-foot emanation, granting you a +3 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392) and to make [Requests](/Actions.aspx?ID=2393) of creatures who are within your aura. **Activate—Compelled Nonviolence** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), incapacitation, [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The wings of this robe extend, and your aura glows golden, briefly becoming visible as it does. Creatures within your aura who are [hostile](/Conditions.aspx?ID=80), [indifferent](/Conditions.aspx?ID=82), or [unfriendly](/Conditions.aspx?ID=97) to you must attempt a DC 36 Will saving throw with the following effects. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) 1.
**Failure** The creature is stunned 2.
**Critical Failure** As failure, and the creature can’t use any [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=2251) against you for 1 round.

<title

    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Robe of Eyes](/Equipment.aspx?ID=463)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 615

**Price** 13,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This garment appears to be an ordinary robe until donned, at which point numerous strange and alien eyes of varied shapes and colors open and blink across its fabric. While wearing the robe, you gain a +3 item bonus to Perception checks, and you constantly benefit from the effects of a 2nd-level [_see invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=271) spell.

 You can also see powerful magic auras. The highest-level magic aura within 30 feet of you glows in a color that reveals its school to you and allows you to determine where the effect originates. This can narrow down the origin point of the effect to a 5-foot-cube, but not more precisely than that.

 The _robe of eyes_ is not without its dangers. If any spell with the light trait is cast on you or your square while you are wearing the robe, you are blinded for a number of rounds equal to the spell’s level unless you succeed at a Fortitude save against the spell’s DC.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You pluck an eye from the robe and toss it into the air, where it turns invisible and floats to a destination you choose, with the same effect as a 5th-level [_prying eye_](/Spells.aspx?ID=239) spell. You can Sustain the Activation just as you would be able to Sustain the Spell. 

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 7"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Root Boots](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3137)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 74

**Price** 360 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn boots

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The soles of these plain leather boots look like coils of flattened roots. The boots allow for full-foot flexibility despite their sturdy make and smell faintly of evergreen trees. While worn and invested, your footsteps sound like rustling leaves, granting you a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks in a forest or wooded area. 

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The small roots extending from the soles of these boots allow you to move freely and easily across wood. For 10 minutes, you gain a 20-foot climb Speed on trees and other wooden surfaces, and you don't need to use your hands to climb. 

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You're standing on earth, and something attempts to move you against your will;  **Effect** The roots extend from your boots to grip the ground, granting you a +4 item bonus to your Fortitude DC against effects that attempt to move you, such as Shove or Pull.

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 0"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rubbing Set](/Equipment.aspx?ID=874)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 115

**Price** 1 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Hands** 2

**Bulk** 1
</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

By using a rubbing set, you can quickly make a copy of carvings or etchings you find during your explorations, making them easier to accurately reproduce. This kit consists of a roll of thin onion-skin paper in a waterproof leather case, several thick wax crayons, and a bar of sealing wax that can be melted and used to temporarily hold the paper in place while you take the rubbing. Using the kit consumes the materials and provides a +1 item bonus on checks to document or reproduce artwork or writing that has been carved, etched, or otherwise physically added to a surface.

>
[Sacred Valkyrie Helm](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3648)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Holy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=517" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #206: Bring the House Down](/Sources.aspx?ID=247) pg. 82

**Price** 40,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Lightning crackles from the wings flanking this helm, which is emblazoned with images of valkyries in the service of benevolent deities. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks and gain [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586) [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 20. When you [invest](/Actions.aspx?ID=2799) in the helm, you either increase your Strength score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score. If you are [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), you become [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) 2 as long as you wear the helm.

**Activate—Path of the Pegasus** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _sacred valkyrie helm_ casts [_interplanar teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1576) to your specifications. When you start this activation, each creature you target with this spell mounts a conjured pegasus who then carries them through reality to arrive at the specified location; each affected creature experiences the 10-minute activation as a kaleidoscopic ride through strange worlds and realities atop a pegasus’s back.

**Activate—Storm's Arms** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The helm casts a 9th-rank [_weapon storm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1758) to your specifications. At your option, all damage caused by this spell is [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586) damage—in this option, the duplicated weapons created by the spell appear to be made of lightning.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 189 **Price** 24,000 gp **Usage** worn belt **Bulk** 1 --- The thin, glittering strands of rope that comprise this thick belt appear to be spun gold. Strung along the front of the belt are a collection of four multicolored, perfectly spherical beads: jade, turquoise, quartz, and amethyst. While wearing the lash, you gain a +3 item bonus to [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13). When you invest the belt, you either increase your Wisdom score by 2 or to 18, whichever would give you a higher score. **Activate** command, Interact; **Effect** You touch one of the jewels affixed to the sage's lash and speak a command word. Depending on the jewel, a different effect is produced that affects you and all living creatures in a 30-foot emanation. After the effect occurs, all four jewels disappear from the lash, reappearing at the next dawn.
  • **Jade** ([healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=128)) Speak “purity” to produce a wave of green light that ends any [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) condition and any [ongoing poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) affecting creatures in the emanation.
  • **Turquoise** Speak “clarity” to grant all affected a +2 status bonus to their next Will save for 1 minute.
  • **Quartz** ([healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=128)) Speak “lenity” to have each creature regain 30 Hit Points.
  • **Amethyst** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100), [revelation](/Traits.aspx?ID=138)) Speak “verity” to emit a magical trail of light from the lash that reveals the location of each creature in the emanation. For 1 round, if they would be [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26), they become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) instead, and if they would be [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39) or [unnoticed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=41) by a creature, they're [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22) instead. A creature can attempt a DC 43 [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) check to avoid the lash's detection.

    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Sash of Books](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2529)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Stolen Fate</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 70

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This elegant black sash features stylized crimson books embroidered at either end and a set of simple tassels. While wearing the sash, you feel as if you have a better understanding of the people and life around you. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) checks.

 When you invest the sash, you either increase your Intelligence score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per minute;   **Effect** You focus on a creature you can see and attempt to gain an instinctual understanding of the creature. You attempt a check to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about the creature, rolling twice and taking the higher result. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. Regardless of the result, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the creature and to your AC and saving throws against attacks and effects from the creature for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +2 if you critically succeeded your check to Recall Knowledge.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You become keenly aware of your surroundings and become able to anticipate dangers. You gain the effects of [_foresight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=127).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

This humble sash can be worn around the waist or across the chest. A sash of prowess often bears a coloration or a pattern that represents the monastery in which you trained but can also sport religious symbology, such as the open hand of Irori. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) and [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) skill checks.

**Activate—Effortless Mastery** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You succeed at an Acrobatics or Athletics skill check; **Effect** You critically succeed instead.

**Activate—Reserves of Inner Strength** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a qi spell. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it's lost.

**Craft Requirements** You're a monk who can cast qi spells.

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 180 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L --- Carved from a scale of the [kaiju](/Traits.aspx?ID=383) Igroon, this jagged shield refracts light around it in a shimmering haze. A _scale of Igroon_ (Hardness 20, HP 160, BT 80) recovers 4 Hit Points at the start of its wielder's turn. When you [Raise a Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=98), you can use the [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=839) reaction with the scale of Igroon to block an attack or effect that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, or sonic damage as well as physical damage. **Activate** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Requirements** You're in an area of [bright](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) or [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408); **Effect** You angle the shield to refract light. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +4 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=62) and [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=63) and can do so while [observed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=27). This bonus ends if you Activate another ability or use the Shield Block reaction. **Activate** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Requirements** You're in an area of bright light; **Effect** You angle the shield at a target within 60 feet, reflecting light into its eyes. It must attempt a DC 42 Fortitude save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1) until its next turn begins.
**Failure** The target is blinded for 1 minute.
**Critical Failure** The target is blinded for 2d4 hours. **Activate** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Trigger** You use Shield Block and prevent yourself from taking energy damage from a line, ray, or a direct attack, including a [_force barrage_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1536) spell; **Effect** You reflect the energy along a trajectory you choose. The effect travels only up to its remaining range, using its original parameters if it strikes other targets. **Destruction** If a deity, kaiju, spawn of a deity, titan, or being of similar power stomps on a _scale of Igroon_ while in absolute darkness, the shield is destroyed permanently.

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 6"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Schematic Scanner](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3800)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Shades of Blood</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 80

**Price** 230 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _schematic scanner_ is a complex brass device featuring multiple mounted lenses, clamps, and apertures. A _schematic scanner_ can hold the formulas for items as if it were a formula book with unlimited capacity. You can add a formula to the _schematic scanner_ using the Store Schematics activation. A _schematic scanner_ grants you a +2 item bonus to [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37) checks to craft an item whose formula is stored in the _schematic scanner_. 

**Activate—Store Schematics** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You place the written formula for an item into the _schematic scanner_ and view it through the mounted lenses, magically storing a copy of the formula inside the _schematic scanner_.

**Activate—Reverse Engineer Schematics** <actions string="" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You place an item in front of the _schematic scanner_, then view the item through the mounted lenses, magically learning the formula for the targeted item, without disassembling or causing harm to the item, and storing the formula in the _schematic scanner_. Reverse engineering a formula in this way takes 10 minutes and doesn’t cost any gold.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Scholarly Journal](/Equipment.aspx?ID=64)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 291

**Price** 6 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Hands** 1

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Scholarly journals are uncommon. Each scholarly journal is a folio on a very specific topic, such as vampires or the history of a single town or neighborhood of a city. If you spend 1 minute referencing an academic journal before attempting a skill check to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about the subject, you gain a +1 item bonus to the check. A compendium of journals costs five times as much as a single journal and requires both hands to use; each compendium contains several journals and grants its bonus on a broader topic, such as all undead or a whole city. The GM determines what scholarly journals are available in any location.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Scope of Truth](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1216)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 182

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Characters with access to firearms gain access to accessories that can be used with those weapons. Replace the word "transmutation" in the scope of truth with the word "polymorph."_

**Price** 3,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** attached to firearm or crossbow (scope)

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _scope of truth_ is a bit bigger than most to accommodate larger lenses, which have been magically prepared with tiny shards from crystal balls to reveal the truth. The scope grants you a +2 item bonus to Perception checks made to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) in areas you can see through the scope.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** For the next 10 minutes, you can see things through the scope as they actually are. The GM rolls a [secret](/Traits.aspx?ID=142) [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check with a +20 counteract modifier and a counteract level of 7 against any [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92) or [transmutation](/Traits.aspx?ID=157) in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it, not to end the spell or effect. For instance, if the check succeeds against a [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127) spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the spell.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3+"
    pfs=""
>
[Secret-Keeper's Mask](/Equipment.aspx?ID=914)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Each of these full-face masks is made of stitched materials—often including humanoid skin—and has a single, bulbous eye. While wearing the mask, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=47) and the mask doesn't impair your vision. The mask can also be activated, with an ability based on its type.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs=""
>
Secret-Keeper's Mask (Blackfingers)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

This featureless mask is made of thin, papery skin. Its single eye is a fragile bubble of venom-filled glass.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You twist the mask's eye and peer at an object. You know whether the object is poison or has been poisoned, but you don't learn the number or type of poisons present in the object.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 5"
pfs=""
>
Secret-Keeper's Mask (Gray Master)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

This monochrome mask is made of tattered rags of gray and black cloth and bleached fragments of skin.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You succeed on a [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) check to [Steal](/Actions.aspx?ID=68) an item of negligible Bulk;  **Effect** You create an illusory duplicate of the item you just stole. This duplicate has the appropriate appearance and weight, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. The illusion vanishes after 10 minutes, or earlier if anyone examines or manipulates the illusory duplicate (such as to try to use it).

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs=""
>
Secret-Keeper's Mask (Father Skinsaw)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

**Price** 250 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

This mask is a patchwork of tanned skins, each with a distinctive scar. It is contorted into a caricature of a face with a leering eye.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You deal [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) to a creature;  **Effect** The bleeding wound you cause is particularly mutilating. The DC of flat checks to recover from the persistent bleed damage is increased by 2, and the target creature has a –2 status penalty to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5), [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6), and [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks while it is bleeding and for 1 minute after it ceases bleeding.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs=""
>
Secret-Keeper's Mask (Reaper of Reputation)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

This mask is made of gray and black tiles sewn together. It has a messy, inky spiral over the mouth.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact (auditory, linguistic);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch the mask's spiral and identify a target creature within 30 feet. For the next 10 minutes, any normal speech you utter can, at your discretion, be inaudible to all creatures except the target creature, who can hear you clearly regardless of ambient sound so long as it is within 1 mile. This ability doesn't silence magical words, such as the verbal component of spellcasting or commands to activate magic items.

While wearing the mask, you gain a +1 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie and the mask doesn't impair your vision. The mask can also be activated, with an ability based on its type. Item 3 Secret-Keeper's Mask (Blackfingers) Source GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask Price 60 gp This featureless mask is made of thin, papery skin. Its single eye is a fragile bubble of venom-filled glass. Activate Two Actions Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You twist the mask's eye and peer at an object. You know whether the object is poison or has been poisoned, but you don't learn the number or type of poisons present in the object. Item 5 Secret-Keeper's Mask (Gray Master) Source GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask Price 150 gp This monochrome mask is made of tattered rags of gray and black cloth and bleached fragments of skin. Activate Reaction Interact; Frequency once per day; Trigger You succeed on a Thievery check to Steal an item of negligible Bulk; Effect You create an illusory duplicate of the item you just stole. This duplicate has the appropriate appearance and weight, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. The illusion vanishes after 10 minutes, or earlier if anyone examines or manipulates the illusory duplicate (such as to try to use it). Item 6 Secret-Keeper's Mask (Father Skinsaw) Source GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask Price 250 gp This mask is a patchwork of tanned skins, each with a distinctive scar. It is contorted into a caricature of a face with a leering eye. Activate Reaction Interact; Frequency once per day; Trigger You deal persistent bleed damage to a creature; Effect The bleeding wound you cause is particularly mutilating. The DC of flat checks to recover from the persistent bleed damage is increased by 2, and the target creature has a –2 status penalty to Deception, Diplomacy, and Performance checks while it is bleeding and for 1 minute after it ceases bleeding. Item 3 Secret-Keeper's Mask (Reaper of Reputation) Source GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask Price 60 gp This mask is made of gray and black tiles sewn together. It has a messy, inky spiral over the mouth. Activate Single Action Interact (auditory, linguistic); Frequency once per day; Effect You touch the mask's spiral and identify a target creature within 30 feet. For the next 10 minutes, any normal speech you utter can, at your discretion, be inaudible to all creatures except the target creature, who can hear you clearly regardless of ambient sound so long as it is within 1 mile. This ability doesn't silence magical words, such as the verbal component of spellcasting or commands to activate magic items.

fields.item_bonus_note: Item bonus to Intimidation checks
fields.markdown:
May contain spoilers from Shades of Blood **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 360 gp **Usage** worn --- When displayed prominently, this iron badge grants you authority and gravitas. You gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks. **Activate—Authoritative Command** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=631), [linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=642), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Effect** You shout at a foe within 60 feet, compelling them to stand in place and drop everything they’re holding. The target attempts a DC 23 Will save with the following results. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 as it does one of the following at the beginning of its next turn: stand in place or release what it’s holding.
**Failure** The target is slowed 2 as it stands in place and releases what it’s holding at the beginning of its next turn.
**Critical Failure** The target is slowed 3 as it spends its next turn to stand in place, release what it’s holding, and place its hands in the air. **Special** A creature wearing an invested security badge within En-Gokal gains additional benefits, as noted in the [adventure text](/Sources.aspx?ID=258).

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 137 **Usage** held in 2 hands **Bulk** L --- This ivory flute is adorned with many carvings of eyes. Each has jade pupils and a semiprecious stone as its iris. The eyes flutter open and closed when the flute is played, as if it held the eyes of many independent beings. While playing the flute, you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks and [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from this instrument to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed levels of all listed spells.   • **Cantrip** [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142), [_read aura_](/Spells.aspx?ID=246)
  • **1st** [_object reading_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2012)

  • **2nd** [_augury_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1445), _object reading_, [_see the unseen_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1663)
  • **3rd** [_clairaudience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=39), [_hypercognition_](/Spells.aspx?ID=156), [_wanderer's guide_](/Spells.aspx?ID=368)
Seer's Flute (Major) **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 137 **Price** 1,900 gp **Bulk** L --- The item bonuses are +2.
  • **4th** _clairvoyance_, [_object reading_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2012), [_read omens_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1647)
  • **5th** [_inevitable disaster_](/Spells.aspx?ID=930), [_scouting eye_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1661), [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728)

>
[Self-Emptying Pocket](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1656)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Contract" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=329" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 165

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

You never perform to an empty crowd after promising any profits to a phantom in a playhouse, sealed by holes that appear in your pockets. By meeting with the attendees at your events, you can use [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) instead of [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) to [Gather Information](/Actions.aspx?ID=49). When you would use Performance to [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23), you don't earn any gold pieces, as the money disappears before you can even count it.

 The entity that holds your _bargained contract_ can influence your reception any time you perform for a crowd or Activate the pocket. If they influence your performance favorably, you gain a +2 item bonus to your Performance check. If they influence your performance unfavorably, you gain a -2 item penalty to your Performance check. If you've failed to earn the entity money in quite a while, it typically influences your performance unfavorably.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You exercise all of your charm on a creature, turning a chance meeting into an impromptu performance that commands attention. Attempt a single Performance check against the Perception DC of the creature. On a success, the creature is affected as though by a successful Deception check to [Create a Diversion](/Actions.aspx?ID=45). The entity that holds your contract can influence this performance as well.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 146 **Price** 1,250 gp **Usage** held in 2 hands **Bulk** L --- This semaphore set consists of two hardwood poles painted white, with finely crafted silk flags bisected by yellow and red fields. A tiny stylized black serpent with its tongue extended is depicted on the top outer corner of each flag. The _semaphore of slanders_, in addition to being a functioning semaphore set, can be used to send false signals to any enemy forces observing the signaler, providing a +2 item bonus to Deception checks to do so, and allies are always aware of this ruse. **Activate—Insidious Insinuation** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You activate the semaphore to mislead the enemy. Choose a creature within 60 feet to attempt a DC 28 Will saving throw. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 1.
**Failure** The target is frightened 1 and is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) for 1 round.
**Critical Failure** The target is frightened 2 and off-guard for 2 rounds.

---

The type of animal tongue used in this tomato-based stew shifts from region to region, but it's always cooked with spirit of wine and seasoned with [refined pesh](/Equipment.aspx?ID=626). Eating this restaurant-staff favorite empowers you to speak and understand a single language for 1 hour. This must be a language the stew's cook could speak and understand, chosen at the time of the stew's creation. It also helps your words land smoothly, granting you a +2 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks made in that language for the same duration. It doesn't allow you to read the newly acquired language in its written form.

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

</row>

---

This finely wrought sextant is made from silver with several onyx mirrors and shades made from thin sets of crystal glass. A fine spyglass made of silver is affixed to the frame; removing the spyglass destroys the sextant. By all appearances, the sextant shouldn’t function, as the shades and mirrors are swapped, but when you look through the spyglass, you see a night sky during the day and the sun during the night, as if day and night were inverted. 

When you use the sextant, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) checks, which increases to a +2 item bonus when you [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=2406).

</column>

>
[Shadewither Key](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1818)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Gatewalkers</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Shadow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=143" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #187: The Seventh Arch](/Sources.aspx?ID=192) pg. 79

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This palm-sized talisman hangs on a string of braided bark fibers. It resembles a leaf from some unknown tree similar to oak, carved from jade and then dipped halfway into black ink that looks wet despite feeling completely dry. The gate key was originally created to open the aiudara known as the _Seventh Arch_. In recent years, corrupting magic has given it additional, stranger powers.

 When you wear and invest _the Shadewither Key_, shadows gather around you. You gain a +1 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks. However, this boon comes with great risk: any [elf](/Traits.aspx?ID=58) who touches _the Shadewither Key_ is immediately afflicted with the [_obnubilate curse_](/Curses.aspx?ID=49).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;     **Effect** You touch _the Shadewither Key_ and command the shadows it casts around you to peel away. The shadows form an umbral double that resembles you in every way except for its fiery red eyes and the expression of wicked delight on its face. The double occupies the same space as you and attempts to intercept any attacks aimed at you. A creature must succeed at a DC 11 flat check when targeting you with an attack, spell, or other effect; on a failure, they hit the shadowy double instead of you. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until the double is hit, whichever comes first. Once the double is hit, it's destroyed. As long as the double exists, you don't gain _the Shadewither Key's_ item bonus to Stealth checks.

**Destruction** _The Shadewither Key's_ magic can be destroyed by exposing the artifact to uncontained teleportation energies. If touched to an unlinked or malfunctioning _aiudara_, _the Shadewither Key_ causes the gate to connect to a new counterpart. If this happens, the key's magic leaves it, rendering the item useless.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 104

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>
