---

This black cape flows more like a vaporous liquid than fabric. The cape grants you a +3 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks. When you invest the cape, you either increase your Dexterity modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value
.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** A creature misses you with an attack;  **Effect** Attempt a Stealth check against the triggering creature's Perception DC. If you roll a success, you're [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22) from that creature until the end of your next turn or until right after you use a [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) against that creature. If you roll a critical success, you're hidden from that creature until the end of your next turn, even if you use hostile actions against that creature.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** With a twirl of the cape, you transform yourself into a puff of gray smoke. You cast [_vapor form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1738) on yourself.

This sandy-textured robe comes with sleeves that resemble dorsal fins. The sharkskin robe grants you a swim Speed equal to your land Speed and a +2 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks.

**Source** [Shining Kingdoms](/Sources.aspx?ID=265) pg. 149 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Characters from Kyonin have access to this option. When using a _shawl of seasons_, the season is the current season where the player is located._ **Price** 150 gp **Usage** worn **Bulk** L --- This woven shawl changes its color, material, and abilities with the seasons. In its usual state, it reflects the current season of the environment the wearer is in. The handsome embroidery grants you a +2 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392). **Activate—Change of Seasons** 10 minutes ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You arrange the shawl on your shoulders to gain the benefits of a season of your choice until your next daily preparations. If the season you choose is the current season, you also gain a +1 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws.
  • **Spring** The shawl becomes smooth silk covered in delicate flowers. You gain a +5-foot item bonus to your Speed.
  • **Summer** The shawl becomes light cotton with the hues of fresh grass. You’re protected from the effects of [severe heat](/Rules.aspx?ID=2820).
  • **Fall** The shawl becomes thin leather with an ombre of red and orange leaves. You treat [falls](/Rules.aspx?ID=2352) as 10 feet shorter.
  • **Winter** The shawl becomes warm wool as white as snow. You’re protected from the effects of severe cold.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 43

**Price** 70,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

In bright light, this dark cloak shimmers with patches of color that shift and move even when the cloth is still. In dim light or darkness, the cloak seems to blend into your surroundings and grants you a +3 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Interact (1 minute);     **Effect** You and objects you wear or carry fall into your shadow, becoming a two-dimensional silhouette. In this form you aren't incorporeal, but you also don't have a solid form and don't occupy your space, allowing other creatures to pass through or end their turn there. You gain resistance 20 to all damage except [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75) damage, damage from effects with the [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100) trait, and damage from Strikes with the [ghost touch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=297) property rune. This increases to resistance 40 against nonmagical damage. Other creatures can't attempt Strength-based skill checks against you. Your land and climb Speeds both become 40 feet. You can't use actions except [Climb](/Actions.aspx?ID=33), Step, or Stride actions using the granted Speeds or an Interact activation to return to your normal form. If your current space doesn't have sufficient room for you to return to your normal form, you return to your normal form in the nearest open space.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You take damage;  **Effect** You fold the cloak over yourself and vanish into your shadow for a moment, gaining the benefits of the first activation until the end of the current creature's turn. The damage resistance applies to the triggering damage.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 19"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Silvanshee Collar](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3649)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Holy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=517" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #206: Bring the House Down](/Sources.aspx?ID=247) pg. 82

**Price** 40,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _silvanshee collar_ appears as a collar of prismatic cloth affixed with a tiny bell, but once worn on the body or affixed to your hair, a Tiny [cat](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=376) wearing a similar (but nonmagical) collar appears at your feet. This cat is similar to a [silvanshee](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1055) [agathion](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=216), but its stats are determined as if you gained the [Pet](/Feats.aspx?ID=5186) general feat. When you first [invest](/Actions.aspx?ID=2799) the collar, you must name your silvanshee pet, then build its statistics as detailed in the Pet general feat. The silvanshee has a name (chosen by you) and a unique personality. Whenever you invest the same silvanshee collar, the silvanshee who appears is the same one you named and chose the first time. If you already have a pet, familiar, or other companion that uses the Pet feat, that pet can change its shape as an action to appear as a silvanshee agathion at will (while perhaps retaining some of your pet’s cosmetic traits at your option), but this doesn’t otherwise alter your existing pet’s statistics.

As long as you wear the silvanshee collar, you gain a +3 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks and a +2 circumstance bonus to [Gather Information](/Actions.aspx?ID=2391). When you invest it, you either increase your Charisma score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score. If you are [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), you become [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 2 as long as you wear the collar.

**Activate—Awww!** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=612), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You fail on an attempt to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=2389) or Make an Impression; **Requirements** Your pet can observe you; **Effect** Your pet does something distracting or adorable at the precise moment you failed, allowing you to reroll the failed check and to use the result of your choice as the actual result.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.markdown:
May contain spoilers from Curtain Call **Source** [Pathfinder #205: Singer, Stalker, Skinsaw Man](/Sources.aspx?ID=246) pg. 84 **Price** 15,000 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L **Base Weapon** [Sickle](/Weapons.aspx?ID=364) --- A _sinew-song_ is an ivory violin bow that bears an odd string, one that vibrates on its own, creating the soft sound of violin music whenever it’s swung through the air. When used to play a violin, this ivory bow functions normally but grants a +3 item bonus to any [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) check attempted as a result. It can also be used to mime playing a violin when no instrument is at hand, but in this case, it grants no item bonus to resulting Performance checks. A _sinew-song’s_ primary use is as a weapon—it can be wielded as if it were a _[+3 ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [keen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2843) [ greater thundering](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2850) [ greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [ sickle](/Weapons.aspx?ID=364)_. **Activate—Cutting Cadenza** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) once and then swipe the weapon through the air three times. Shimmering waves of sound slice out in a 30-foot [cone](/Rules.aspx?ID=2386). All creatures in the area must attempt a DC 37 Reflex save. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature takes damage as if you successfully hit it with a [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) using a _sinew-song_, but all of the damage is sonic damage.
**Failure** As success, but the creature also takes 2d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86).
**Critical Failure** As success, but double the damage and the creature takes 4d6 persistent bleed damage.

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 92

**Price** 500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** etched onto heavy armor

</row>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Knights of Lastwall has access to this option.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

_Sinister knight_ armor shrouds the wearer’s identity in secrecy, allowing Crimson Reclaimers to pass among foes without being immediately unmasked. The wearer gains a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** With a thought, the wearer activates a disguise. While the _sinister knight_ armor’s disguise is active, any identifying insignia or aesthetic of the armor is replaced by generic malevolent aesthetics such as spikes or demonic faces. While in the disguise, the wearer is always considered to be taking precautions against [lifesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=21), and even a creature that successfully notices the wearer with its lifesense mistakes the wearer for an undead unless it critically succeeds at its Perception check or the wearer critically fails a Deception or [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) check. Finally, while in the disguise, the rune attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=299) any effects that would reveal your alignment; on a successful counteract check, rather than negate the effect, the rune causes the effect to perceive your alignment as evil (maintaining any lawful or chaotic component of your alignment).

 The wearer can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=74) the disguise, and if the wearer’s armor is removed, the disguise deactivates automatically.

</column>

The recorder grants you a +1 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks while playing music with the instrument. **Activate—Sooth Serpents** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You play a swift composition that fascinates all snakes, pythons, vipers, and serpents that hear it. </title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />

<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 155, [Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under](/Sources.aspx?ID=47) pg. 76

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A patchwork of [humanoid](/Traits.aspx?ID=628) flesh makes up a _skinsaw mask_, which is stitched together with black silk or wire. It is distinctive for its bulbous orange eye—crafted from a magical glass bauble—and wide row of teeth. When worn, the mask amplifies your ability to sense fear in other creatures. You know the value of the [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) condition of any observed creature, and you gain a +1 item bonus to [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2298) checks to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301) frightened creatures. Whenever you deal precision damage to a frightened creature, you deal 1 additional precision damage. If you aren’t [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), you are [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) 2 while wearing a _skinsaw mask_.

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 296

**Price** 55 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This sticky salve stubbornly holds wounds closed and encourages swift natural healing. You can activate the salve in either of the following ways.

**Activate—Administer Stitch** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You [Administer First Aid](/Actions.aspx?ID=2396) without requiring healer's tools. You can either gain a +2 item bonus to the [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=42) check or use the salve's Medicine modifier of +13 instead of your own.

**Activate—Stitch Wounds** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))  **Trigger** You [Treat Wounds](/Actions.aspx?ID=2399) or use [Battle Medicine](/Feats.aspx?ID=5125);  **Effect** You gain a +2 item bonus to the triggering [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=42) check. If you roll a success on the Medicine check, you get a critical success instead.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 11"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Skirmisher's Coat](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3696)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Spore War</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt](/Sources.aspx?ID=253) pg. 79

**Price** 1,300 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Valued among soldiers (particularly those from wartorn Nirmathas) who often find themselves operating undercover, this large-collared garment is reminiscent of a highwayman’s coat. A skirmisher’s coat is cleverly constructed, and contains several concealed pockets and grants the wearer a +2 item bonus to checks made to [Conceal an Object](/Actions.aspx?ID=2403).

**Activate—Costume Change** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629))    **Effect** You change the shape and appearance of all your clothing, making them appear as ordinary or fine clothes of your imagining. This doesn’t change the statistics of any armor you’re wearing. Only a creature that’s benefiting from [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727) or a similar effect can attempt to disbelieve this illusion, with a DC of 28.

**Activate—Unexpected Armament** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You reach into one of the coat’s pockets and withdraw a chunk of metal that instantly expands into a common simple or martial melee weapon of your choice. The weapon functions as a _[+1 striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) weapon_. When you produce the weapon, you decide if it is made from [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2916) or [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920), and which one of the following property runes it gains: [corrosive](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2834), [flaming](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2838), [frost](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2839), [shock](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2847), or [thundering](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2850). This weapon remains for 1 hour or until it leaves your grasp, at which point it vanishes.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 205 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L --- A famed detective once owned the long, curved _sleuth's pipe_, taking it with them on investigations, keeping it in hand or mouth while cogitating. The pipe might have passed down through generations. Or, when an owner dies without heirs, it could go up for auction, be given to family friends, or remain at the scene of a crime to be found later. The _sleuth's pipe_ has sapience that eventually awakens, allowing the relic to act as a helpful assistant in investigations. Even while this sapience sleeps within the pipe, it grants you a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=85), and if you're an [investigator](/Classes.aspx?ID=13), any checks you make to [Pursue a Lead](/Actions.aspx?ID=544). --- **Minor Gifts**: [beginner's luck](/Relics.aspx?ID=97), [repository of knowledge](/Relics.aspx?ID=51)
**Major Gifts**: [intelligent relic](/Relics.aspx?ID=109), [steal luck](/Relics.aspx?ID=101)
**Grand Gift**: [mental bastion](/Relics.aspx?ID=54)

fields.text: Item 3 Sleuth's Pipe Unique Magical Relic Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 205 Usage held in 1 hand Bulk L A famed detective once owned the long, curved sleuth's pipe , taking it with them on investigations, keeping it in hand or mouth while cogitating. The pipe might have passed down through generations. Or, when an owner dies without heirs, it could go up for auction, be given to family friends, or remain at the scene of a crime to be found later. The sleuth's pipe has sapience that eventually awakens, allowing the relic to act as a helpful assistant in investigations. Even while this sapience sleeps within the pipe, it grants you a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to Sense Motive, and if you're an investigator, any checks you make to Pursue a Lead. Minor Gifts : beginner's luck, repository of knowledge Major Gifts : intelligent relic, steal luck Grand Gift : mental bastion

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 193

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A silver charm bracelet, a _sluggish bracelet_ appears to be a [_bracelet of dashing_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=415), granting you a +1 item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks. If the curse goes unrecognized, you think you can Activate it to gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed for 1 minute. Instead, its activation is as follows.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))    **Effect** You take a –10-foot penalty to your Speed for 1 minute, and the bracelet fuses to you. Thereafter, it grants you no bonus to Acrobatics checks, and it imposes a –5-foot status penalty to your Speed.

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Smoke Veil](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2609)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 124

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

_Smoke veils_ are wigs or headdresses made of flame and ash, giving the wearer a burning coil of fiery hair and concealing their face behind a smoldering, omnipresent haze of smoke and sparking embers. You can use the veil to go unrecognized by hiding your face so that you can attempt [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46) without needing a [disguise kit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=19). When you do so, it takes you only 1 minute to create the disguise, and you gain a +1 item bonus to the check. You still need a disguise kit and the full time if you're using cosmetics and other props to change other aspects of your disguise, or if Impersonating a specific person.

**Activate—Blazing Stare** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32))   **Requirements** You dealt fire damage to a target you can see within 30 feet with your most recent action this turn; **Effect** You set your fiery gaze on your target, eyes burning within a cloud of ash and cinder. Roll an [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) check to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=53) the target. Demoralize loses the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16) trait and gains the [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163) trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

    level="1"
    right="Item 15"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Songbird's Brush](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1760)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Kingmaker</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Good" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=83" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Kingmaker Companion Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=151) pg. 84

**Price** 6,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Glaive](/Weapons.aspx?ID=20)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The blade of this _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [holy](/Equipment.aspx?ID=299) [glaive](/Weapons.aspx?ID=20)_ shimmers with a prismatic sheen, as if faintly reflecting a rainbow. A _songbird's brush_ sheds [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 40 feet). When wielded in combat, the sound of the blade cutting through the air creates a soft, musical trill as if produced by a songbird. Sacred to the faithful of [Shelyn](/Deities.aspx?ID=17), a _songbird's brush_ is so named for the fighting style developed by worshippers of the Eternal Rose, which equates its sweeping swings to painting with a brush. A songbird's brush grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks made to dance or sing as long as the glaive is held in two hands.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You sweep the _songbird's brush_ in an arc before you, casting [_prismatic spray_](/Spells.aspx?ID=233) from the glaive. The spell DC is 34. This _prismatic spray_ does not affect good-aligned creatures in its area.

**Craft Requirements** You are a worshipper of Shelyn.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This _+1 resilient [studded leather armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=5)_ is adorned with colorful sequins that sparkle in even the faintest light. >
[Spectacles of Discernment](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3631)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #204: Stage Fright](/Sources.aspx?ID=245) pg. 80

**Price** 3,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Designed for a frequent sponsor of theatrical productions who liked to stay informed of all the off-stage drama, these silver opera glasses are affixed to a slender redwood handle. They can’t be worn on the face but must be raised to the eyes and held there, at which point the spectacles of discernment grant a +2 item bonus to [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2298) checks to notice details at a distance.

**Activate—Reveal the Truth** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You raise the spectacles to regard a target creature through them; the target must be within 60 feet. You immediately gain the ability to speak and understand the language the target creature is currently speaking, or its native language if it’s not currently talking, for 24 hours. During this time, you can Interact with the spectacles of discernment to flip down a pair of supplementary lenses. When you do so, if you’re observing the creature you originally targeted, roll a secret [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=3280) check with a counteract modifier of +23 against any [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [morph](/Traits.aspx?ID=657), or [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) effect affecting the target, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through the disguise or not.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Spectacles of Inquiry](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2316)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 147

**Price** 1,750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Anything viewed through these thin spectacles looks crisp and clear, and the earpieces accentuate sounds around you. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The spectacles key in on someone to show you their social cues in perfect clarity. Choose a creature you can see. You gain a +3 item bonus on Perception checks you make to use [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=85) against that creature. This benefit lasts until you Activate the item again in this way.

 If you’re an [investigator](/Classes.aspx?ID=59), you can use this activation as part of the [Devise a Stratagem](/Actions.aspx?ID=2813) action (even if you’re doing it as a free action). Alternatively, you can use it as part of the [Pursue a Lead](/Actions.aspx?ID=2811) activity, even though you can’t see the creature. You must choose the same creature you chose for Devise a Stratagem or Pursue a Lead.

**Craft Requirements** You are an investigator.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These folding, wood-framed spectacles hold flat discs of cut crystal as lenses and are held in place with thin cords that wrap around each ear, with another strap holding them around the neck while not in use. While you are wearing the spectacles, you gain a +1 item bonus to checks to [Decipher Writing](/Actions.aspx?ID=22).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Unfolding the spectacles onto the bridge of the nose, you gain the effects of 2nd-level [_comprehend language_](/Spells.aspx?ID=46) for one hour except that it applies to all languages you see rather than a single language, and it does not apply to language you hear.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3"
    pfs=""
>
[Spider Lily Tattoo](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2687)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 82

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _spider lily tattoo_ marks you as a trusted member of Granny Hu's network. This crimson tattoo fades and becomes invisible within a day of being applied, reappearing only when you Activate it, when you gain the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9) condition, or when you die. The higher the doomed value, the more vivid the color. If your tattoo is plainly visible, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks against all creatures that can see the tattoo, but you take a –1 item penalty to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=50) on those who understand the actual meaning of the _spider lily tattoo_ (including all of Willowshore's citizens).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32))   **Requirements** Your tattoo isn't currently visible; **Effect** You make the tattoo visible. You can use this activation again to make the tattoo not visible, unless you have the doomed condition.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** An [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creature detects you for the first time;  **Effect** The _spider lily tattoo_ manipulates your life force to make you appear to be undead for a short time. Attempt a [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) check against the triggering undead creature's Perception DC. On a success, the triggering undead believes you're undead as well—a [mindless](/Traits.aspx?ID=108) undead is likely to ignore you, while a sapient undead might react with curiosity or confusion. You can continue attempting Deception checks each round as a single action to Sustain the effect for up to 1 minute.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.text: Item 3 Spider Lily Tattoo May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts Rare Invested Magical Necromancy Tattoo Source Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was pg. 82 Price 60 gp Usage tattooed on the body The spider lily tattoo marks you as a trusted member of Granny Hu's network. This crimson tattoo fades and becomes invisible within a day of being applied, reappearing only when you Activate it, when you gain the doomed condition, or when you die. The higher the doomed value, the more vivid the color. If your tattoo is plainly visible, you gain a +1 item bonus to Intimidation checks against all creatures that can see the tattoo, but you take a –1 item penalty to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression on those who understand the actual meaning of the spider lily tattoo (including all of Willowshore's citizens). Activate Single Action envision (concentrate) Requirements Your tattoo isn't currently visible; Effect You make the tattoo visible. You can use this activation again to make the tattoo not visible, unless you have the doomed condition. Activate Reaction envision (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Trigger An undead creature detects you for the first time; Effect The spider lily tattoo manipulates your life force to make you appear to be undead for a short time. Attempt a Deception check against the triggering undead creature's Perception DC. On a success, the triggering undead believes you're undead as well—a mindless undead is likely to ignore you, while a sapient undead might react with curiosity or confusion. You can continue attempting Deception checks each round as a single action to Sustain the effect for up to 1 minute.

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3"
    pfs="Restricted"
>
[Spider Lily Tattoo](/Equipment.aspx?ID=4098)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Season of Ghosts (Hardcover)](/Sources.aspx?ID=294) pg. 305

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The spider lily tattoo marks you as a trusted member of Granny Hu’s network. This crimson tattoo fades and becomes invisible within a day of being applied, reappearing only when you Activate it, when you gain the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=67) condition, or when you die. The higher the doomed value, the more vivid the color. [Additional rules for magical tattoos appear here](/Rules.aspx?ID=1495). 

If your tattoo is plainly visible, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks against all creatures that can see the tattoo, but you take a –1 item penalty to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392) on those who understand the actual meaning of the _spider lily tattoo_ (including all of Willowshore’s citizens).

**Activate—Reveal Tattoo** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))   **Requirements** Your tattoo isn't currently visible; **Effect** You make the tattoo visible. You can use this activation again to make the tattoo not visible, unless you have the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=67) condition.

**Activate—Dead Like You** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** An [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) creature detects you for the first time, and you’re aware of the undead creature;  **Effect** The _spider lily tattoo_ manipulates your life force to make you appear to be [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) for a short time. Attempt a [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) check against the triggering undead creature’s Perception DC. On a success, the triggering undead believes you’re undead as well—a mindless undead is likely to ignore you, while a sapient undead might react with curiosity or confusion. You can continue attempting Deception checks each round as a single action to [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) the effect for up to 1 minute.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 147 **Usage** affixed to a metal armor or weapon --- This perfectly octahedral magnetite crystal is covered in a hair-like layer of iron sand that always finds its way back to shape if wiped away. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is +8, and the spell DC is 18.
  • **Armor** You gain a +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks and resistance 2 to [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188) damage.
  • **Weapon** After you cast a spell by Activating the _spiny lodestone_, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d4 piercing damage until the end of your next turn.
**Activate** Cast a Spell **Effect** You cast [_needle darts_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1375). Spiny Lodestone **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 147 **Price** 90 gp Spiny Lodestone (Greater) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 147 **Price** 425 gp --- Resistance when affixed to armor is 5, additional damage when affixed to a weapon is 1d6, the spell attack modifier is +14, and the spell DC is 24. **Activate** Cast a Spell **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You cast [_magnetic acceleration_](/Spells.aspx?ID=943). Spiny Lodestone (Major) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 147 **Price** 1,750 gp --- Bonus to Athletics checks when affixed to armor is +2, resistance when affixed to armor is 10, additional damage when affixed to a weapon is 1d8, the spell attack modifier is +19, and the spell DC is 29. **Activate** Cast a Spell **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You cast 4th-rank _magnetic acceleration_. **Activate** Cast a Spell **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You cast [_rust cloud_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1377).

>
[Spirit-Singer](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1138)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 83

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Etheric spirit-singers create an eerie spectral sound based on the presence of spiritual essence and other ethereal energies. All spirit-singers can be used as musical instruments by manipulating the sensitivity to ethereal energies. However, they have an even greater benefit in areas heavy with spiritual essence. When played in the presence of a significant spiritual disturbance, such as a [haunt](/Traits.aspx?ID=88) or an [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=222) [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160), a spirit-singer grants you a +1 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks. While playing a spirit-singer, you also gain a +1 item bonus to checks to detect a haunt or incorporeal undead, and you can roll a check to notice a haunt even if you aren't actively [Searching](/Actions.aspx?ID=519) for it, due to the distortions of the spirit-singer's music. A haunt or incorporeal undead that is intelligent enough to notice the effects it is having on the spirit-singer's music and that can't otherwise communicate with the living might choose to use the spirit-singer to do so if it wishes. For instance, it could try to guide the spirit-singer player towards a location by creating distortions in that direction or, if it understands language, it could try to answer questions by creating one distortion for yes and two distortions for no. Unless stated otherwise in its usage entry, a spirit-singer functions like a heavy [musical instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=37); rather than carrying it, the musician places the spirit-singer in a particular position and uses both hands to play.
